sa: सोऽयं बलस्थो मूढच न करिष्यति ते वचः। तस्मिन् निरर्थकं वाक्यमुक्तं सम्पत्स्यते तव॥
en: This child (in wisdom) who is such this fool will not do what you say and your words spoken to him will go in vain.

sa: कर्णो वा युध्यतां पूर्वमहं वा पृथिवीपते। स्पर्धते हि सदात्यर्थं सूतपुत्रो मया रणे॥
en: Either let Karna fight first or myself, O lord of the earth. The son of the Suta always compares his prowess in battle with mine,

sa: धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राणामर्थे योत्स्यामि ते सुतैः। बलं च शक्तिं चास्थाय न वै त्वय्यनृतं वदे॥
en: On the side of the sons of Dhritarashtra, shall I fight with your sons with all my might and prowess; I do not speak untruely to you.

sa: विराट उवाच किमर्थं पाण्डवश्रेष्ठ भार्यां दुहितरं मम। प्रतिग्रहीतुं नेमां त्वं मया दत्तामिहेच्छसि॥
en: Virata said O foremost of Pandavas, why do you not wish to accept, as your wife, my daughter whom I wish to confer upon you?

sa: अपृच्छद् राघवो गृधं रावण: कां दिशं गतः। तस्य गृध्रः शिरः कम्पैराचचक्षे ममार च॥
en: Rama then asked the vultures as to the way taken by Ravana. But the vulture indicated it by a nod of the head and then passed away.

sa: युगपत् त्रीणि तेजांसि समेतान्यनुशुश्रुभ। नैवास्ति नो धनुस्तादृक् न योद्धा न च सारथिः॥
en: These there forces have come together, I hear; there is no similar bow, nor a warrior of that stamp, nor a charioteer of that character.

sa: पुपोष चैनं विधिवद् ववृधे स च वीर्यवान्। ततः प्रभृति चाप्यन्ये प्रभावन्नौरसाः सुताः॥
en: She brought him properly up and that mighty boy too began to grow up. Since that time he (Adhiratha) had other sons begotten by him.

sa: एवं ते जीवितं दद्यामेष युद्धजितो विधिः। तमुवाच ततो ज्येष्ठो भ्राता सप्रणयं वचः॥
en: Under this condition I can grant you your life: such is the custom of the victorious." Then his eldest brother addressed to him affectionate words.

sa: अथोत्तरां दिशं गत्वा वशे चक्रे नराधिपान्॥ भगदत्तं च निर्जित्य राधेयो गिरिमारुहत्। हिमवन्तं महाशैलं युध्यमानश्च शत्रुभिः॥ प्रययौ च दिशः सर्वान् नृपतीन् वशमानयत्। स हैमवतिकाञ्जित्वा करं सर्वानदापयत्॥
en: He then brought under subjection all the kings the northern country. Having vanquished Bhagadatta, the son of Rudra (Karna) ascended the great mountain Himalayas fighting all along with many foes. Going on all sides, he conquered and brought under subjection all the kings inhabiting the Himalayas and he made them pay tribute.

sa: धनमाहुः परं धर्मं धने सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्। जीवन्ति धनिनो लोके मृता ये त्वधना नराः॥
en: Wealth is said to be the best virtue. Everything is established on wealth; and wealthy men are living in this world and men without wealth are dead.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अरणीसहितं यस्य मृगो ह्यादाय गच्छति। तस्याग्नयो न लुप्येरन् प्रथमोऽस्तु वरो मम॥
en: Yudhishthira said: May the Agni of the Brahmana whose firesticks are being carried away by that deer, be not destroyed. This the first boon that I crave.

sa: सैन्ध्युवाच अन्ये चैनं वधिष्यन्ति येषामागः करोति सः। मन्ये चैवाद्य सुव्यक्तं यमलोकं गमिष्यति॥
en: Sairandhri said Others whom he has wronged will slay him; I think he will certainly go this very day to the region of Yama (Death).

sa: अश्वपतिरुवाच गुणैरुपेतं सर्वैस्तं भगवन् प्रब्रवीषि मे। दोषानष्यस्य मे ब्रूहि यदि सन्तीह केचन॥
en: Ashvapati said: O adorable one, you have described him as possessed of all noble qualities. Now tell me of his defects, if there be any.

sa: एकः पुत्रो विराटस्य शून्ये संनिहितः पुरे। स एष किल निर्यातो बालभावान्न पौरुषात्॥
en: Excepting Dhananjaya who, in this world, alone can come to fight with us? Only one son of Virata has been left in the empty city.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच याते त्रिगर्तान् मत्स्ये तु पशूस्तान् वै परीप्सति। दुर्योधनः सामात्यो विराटमुपयादथ॥
en: Vaishampayana said After the king of Matsya's had gone out in pursuit of Trigartas for recovering his kine, Duryodhana, with his courtiers, attacked his kingdom.

sa: वर्णावकाशमपि मे पश्य पाण्डव यादृशम्। तादृशो मे न तत्रासीद् दुःखे परमके तदा॥
en: Behold, O son of Pandu, the paleness of my complexion which even in the extremely miserable life in the forest could not come over me.

sa: तासु पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च मम जाता जनार्दन। तासु मे हृदयं कृष्णं संजातं कामबन्धनम्॥
en: On them have been begotten sons and grandsons by me, O Janardana, and on them has the affection of my heårt been fastened, O Krishna.

sa: उपतस्थुः प्रकृतयः समस्ता ब्राह्मणैः सह। सभाजित: ससैन्यस्तु प्रतिनन्द्याथ मत्स्यराट्॥ विसर्जयामास तदा द्विजांश्च प्रकृतीस्तथा। तथा स राजा मत्स्यानां विराटो वाहिनीपतिः॥ उत्तरं परिपप्रच्छ क्व यात इति चाब्रवीत्। आचख्युस्तस्य तत्सर्वं स्त्रियः कन्याश्च वेश्मनि॥ अन्तःपुरचराश्चैव कुरुभिर्गोधनं हृतम्। विजेतुमभिसंरब्ध एक एवातिसाहसात्। बृहन्नलासहायश्च निर्गतः पृथिवीठ्ठायः॥ उपयातानतिरथान् भीष्मं शान्तवनं कृपम्। कर्णं दुर्योधनं द्रोणं द्रोणपुत्रं च षड् रथान्॥
en: All his subjects, along with the Brahmanas and the soldiers, came and adored him. Welcoming them, the king of Matsya sent away the Brahmanas and the subjects. Then the king of Matsya's, Virata, the commander of armies, enquired of Uttara and said “Where has he gone?” Then all the females and girls of the inner apartments said “The kine were taken away by the Kurus. Out o excessive bravery, the conqueror of the earth alone, with Brihannala as his help, went out to vanquish them-the six powerful car-warriors Bhishma the son of Shantanu, Kripa, Karna, Duryodhana, Drona and Drona's son, who all have come.”

sa: क्षुद्रं कृत्वा फलं पापं त्वं प्राप्स्यसि न संशयः। आसाद्य पाण्डवान् वीरान् धर्मराजपुरोगमान्॥
en: Forsooth you shall reap the fruit of your this mean action when you shall meet the heroic Pandavas with the pious Yudhishthira at their head.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच नरदेव कथं तस्य राष्ट्रे कर्म करिष्यसि। विराटनगरे साधो रंस्यसे केन कर्मणा॥
en: Arjuna said O god among men, how will you work in his domain, O virtuous one, in what capacity will you reside in the city of Virata?

sa: न दुःखमुचितं किञ्चिद् राजन् वेद यथा जनः। स इमामापदं प्राप्य कथं घोरां तरिष्यसि॥
en: Like an ordinary person a king is not accustomed to hardships; how will you, as a king, thus get over the awful calamity that has overtaken you.

sa: राजान ऊचुः सत्यमेतद् भवतु ते काक्षितं पुरुषर्षभ। सर्वेषां नः क्रतुफलं धर्मश्च प्रतिगृह्यताम्॥
en: The king said May what was desired for by you le successful; accept the religious merit of these sacrificial ceremonies performed by all of us.

sa: शीघ्रं तापेन चैतस्य तप्यते स सुयोधनः। सगणः सह कर्णेन सौबलेनापि वा विभुः॥
en: By virtue of his valour, Duryodhana in spite of being so mighty shortly punished for his evil tricks with Karna, Shakuni and all other attendants.

sa: इत्येव नियमेन त्वं दद्याः शक्राय कुण्डले। तया त्वं कर्ण संग्रामे हनिष्यसि रणे रिपून्।॥
en: It is under this condition only, O Karna, that you will give your ear-rings to Shakra. Then you will be able to destroy your enemies in battle.

sa: कृष्ण उवाच भवानभिगतः पूर्वमत्र मे नास्ति संशयः। दृष्टस्तु प्रथमं राजन् मया पार्थो धनंजयः॥
en: Srikrishna said I have not the slightest doubt that you came here first, but Dhananjaya, the son of Pritha has been, O king, first seen by me.

sa: बृहस्पतिरथोवाच शक्राणी भयमोहिताम्॥ यदुक्ताऽसि मया देवि सत्यं ध्रुवम्। तद् भविता द्रक्ष्यसे देवराजानमिन्द्रं शीघ्रमिहागतम्॥ न भेतव्यं च नहुषात् सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते। समानयिष्ये शक्रेण न चिराद् भवतीमहम्॥
en: Then did Brihaspati address the panicstricken queen of Indra-"What has been said by me, O goddess, will most certainly prove true. You will soon see the king of the gods, Indra, come here. Nahusha need not be feared by you. I speak this truly. I shall without delay bring Indra near you.

sa: भासि देवि यथा पद्मा नारायणपरिग्रहः॥ स्वरूपं ब्रह्मचर्यं च विशदं गगनेश्वरी। कृष्णच्छविसमा कृष्णा संकर्षणसमानना॥
en: O goddess you appear like Padma the consort of Narayana, O you ranger in the sky, your Brahmacharya and the real forms are both without a spot.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमाख्यायमानं तु छन्नं सत्रेण पाण्डवम्। वसन्तं तत्र नाज्ञासीद् विराटो वाहिनीपतिः॥
en: Vaishampayana says-O Janamejaya! In spite of told impliedly, the king Virata could not recognise Arjuna, the son of Pandu living those hideously as an eunuch.

sa: वपुषा बिभ्रती तां तत्रापश्यत् प्रियां भार्यां पाण्डवानां यशस्विनीम्। तिष्ठन्तीमाश्रमद्वारि द्रौपदी निर्जने वने।॥
en: In that solitary place he found the handsome Draupadi, the beloved and the illustrious wife of the Pandavas, standing at the threshold of the hermitage.

sa: यक्ष उवाच राजन् कुलेन वृत्तेन स्वाध्यायेन श्रुतेन वा। ब्राह्मण्यं केन भवति प्रब्रूह्येतत् सुनिश्चितम्॥
en: The Yaksha said: O king, relate with certainty whether by birth, good character, study of the Vedas or learning or by what a person becomes a Brahmana.

sa: अनवाप्यं च शोकेन शरीरं चोपतप्यते। अमित्राश्च प्रहृष्यन्ति मा स्म शोके मनः कृथाः॥
en: Though one's object is not gained, yet the body is consumed by grief, which makes one's enemies glad; therefore do not give way to grief.

sa: ततः पार्थो महाबाहुः कर्णस्य धनुरच्छिनत्। स शक्तिं प्राहिणोत् तस्मै तां पार्थो व्यधमच्छरैः॥
en: Then the large-armed Arjuna cut off Karnas bow into pieces. He then struck (Arjuna) with a Shakti, but Partha cut it off with his arrows.

sa: विरोचन उवाच तवाहते तु फलकं कूर्च वाप्यथवा बृसी। सुधन्वन्न त्वमोऽसि मया सह समासनम्॥
en: Virochana said You are fit for (sitting on) a plank, a skin or a mat. O Sudhanvan, you are not fit for a seat equal to mine.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच न ते बीभत्सता कर्ण भविष्यति कथञ्चन। व्रपाश्चैव न गात्रेषु यस्त्वं नानृतमिच्छसि॥
en: Indra said: O Karna, since you are are desirous of observing the truth, you will not look ugly nor will there be any scars on your body.

sa: पीड्यन्ते च प्रजाः सर्वाः सदेवासुरमानुषाः। सख्यं भवतु ते वृत्र शक्रेण सह नित्यदा॥
en: All beings including the gods, the Asuras and the human beings, are enduring misery. Let there always exit, O Vritra, friendship between you and Shakra.

sa: शल्य उवाच इत्युक्त्वा तं तदा देवा ऋषिभिः सह भारत। जग्मुर्ब्रहस्पतिं वक्तुमिन्द्राणीं चाशुभं वचः॥
en: Shalya said Saying this, the gods accompanied by the Rishis, O on of Bharata, went to tell this unwelcome news to Brihaspati and the wife of Indra.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ते दृष्ट्वा निहतान् सूतान् राज्ञे गत्वा न्यवेदयन्। गन्धर्वैनिहता राजन् सूतपुत्रा महाबलाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Beholding the Suta's slain, people went and communicated to the king: "O king, the highly powerful sons of Suta have been slain by the Gandharvas.

sa: सत्यवानपि तां भार्यां लब्ध्वा सर्वगुणान्विताम्। मुमुदे सा च तं लब्ध्वा भर्तारं मनसेप्सितम्॥
en: Satyavana having obtained a wife graced with all the (noble) qualities and she (Savitri) too having got a husband after her own heart, rejoiced exceedingly.

sa: कर्मणा केन सिद्धोऽयं क्व वाऽनेन तपश्चितम्। कथं वा ज्ञायते स्वर्गे केन वा ज्ञायतेऽप्युत॥
en: By which deeds did he obtain salvation? In what forest did he practice asceticism? How is he known in heaven and by whom, is he so known?

sa: मञ्जूषा त्वश्वनद्याः सा ययौ चर्मण्वती नदीम्। चर्मण्वत्याश्च यमुनां ततो गङ्गां जगाम ह॥
en: (On the other hand) the basket came from the Ashva to the river Charmavati, from the Charınavati to the Yamuna and thence to the Ganga.

sa: अपि चैव मया श्रेयो वाच्यं तेषां नराधिप। संयोद्धव्यं तवार्थाय यथा मे समयः कृतः॥
en: And it is also my duty to look after their welfare, O ruler of men; but I shall fight on your behalf since I have promised it.

sa: तत्र नः प्रथमः कल्पो यद् वयं ते च माधव। प्रशान्ताः समभूताश्च श्रियं तामश्नुवीमहि॥
en: With regard to that our intention the first thing is to enjoy that prosperity, themselves and ourselves united in peace and with the same interests, O Madhava.

sa: अ च शक्नोषि निर्जेतुं वासवं बलिनां वर। युध्यतोश्चापि वां कालो व्यतीतः सुमहानिह॥
en: O you best of powerful beings, you will not be able to conquer Vasava and a very long period has elapsed since you commenced fighting.

sa: यतः सत्यं यतो धर्मो यतो ह्रीरार्जवं यतः। ततो भवतो गोविन्दो यतः कृष्णस्ततो जयः॥
en: Where there is truth, where there is righteousness, where there is modesty and where there is humanity, there is Govinda. Where there is Krishna; there is victory.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच किमसौ पाण्डवौ राजा धर्मपुत्रोऽभ्यभाषत। श्रुत्वेह बहुला: सेनाः प्रीत्यर्थं नः समागताः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said What did the son of Dharma, the king of the Pandavas, say after hearing that several armies had collected here for our help.

sa: रमते यस्तु पुत्रेण मोघं तस्य प्रजाफलम्। अकुर्वन्तो हि कर्माणि कुर्वन्तो निन्दितानि च॥
en: And he who is pleased with a son who does only such acts as are unrighteous, has the object of his begetting children rendered unsuccessful.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच यदान्यं न वरं ववे भगवान् पाकशासनः। ततः प्रहस्य कर्णस्तं पुनरित्यब्रवीद् वचः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When the exalted chastiser of the (Asura) Paka did not ask for any other boon, then Karna smilingly said to him again these words.

sa: मामासाद्य पतिं भद्रे न त्वं राक्षसवेश्मनि। जरां व्रजेथा इति मे निहतोऽसौ निशाचरः॥
en: O gentle creatures, I have killed that nightranger thinking that myself being your husband you should not grow old in the abode of the Rakshasa.

sa: तस्मिन् बद्धे भविष्यन्ति वृष्णयः पृथिवी तथा। पाण्डवाश्च विधेया मे स च प्रातरिहैष्यति॥
en: On his imprisonment, the Vrishnis and the Pandavas, in fact the whole world, will be at my disposal. Krishna, too, will be here tomorrow morning.

sa: तस्य राजन् स निस्त्रिंशं सुप्रभं च शरावरम्। हतस्य पततो हस्ताद् वेगेन न्यपतद् भुवि॥
en: Then, O monarch, when he was falling down dead, his resplendent sword and shield, loosened from his hands, fell down on th grounds, together with his body.

sa: वार्धक्षत्रिः सर्वसैन्यस्य मध्ये भूरिश्रवाः पुरुमित्रो जयश्च। शाल्वा मत्स्याः केकयाश्चेति सर्वे गजानीकैर्धातरो योत्स्यमानाः॥
en: In the midst of all the troops fought Vardhakshatri, Bhurishrava, Purumitra, Jaya, and the Shalvas, the Matsyas and all the Kaikeyas with their elephants crops.

sa: संजय उवाच सादितं प्रेक्ष्य यन्तारं शल्यः सर्वायसीं गदाम्। समुत्क्षिप्य नदन् क्रुद्धः प्रचस्कन्द रथोत्तमात्॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing his charioteer overthrown, Shalya uplifting a mace wholly made of iron and in rage uttering a loud shout, jumped down from his excellent car.

sa: नायं भूत्वा वा न भूयः। अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे॥
en: It is never born, It never dies, having existed. It does not exist no more. Unborn, everlasting, unchangeable, ancient, It is not killed, Its body being killed.

sa: वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनमजमव्ययम्। कथं स पुरुषः पार्थ कं घातयति हन्ति कम्॥
en: How and whom can that man, O Partha, who knows It (self) to be unborn indestructible, everlasting and imperishable, kill or cause to be killed?

sa: यः पुरा विबुधैः सर्वैः सहाये युद्धदुर्मदः। काक्षितो दानवान् उद्भिः पिता मम महाव्रतः॥
en: In the day of yore when the celestials were fighting with the Danavas, they sought the help of that invincible hero, my great vowobserving father.

sa: अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम्। तथाऽपि त्वं महाबाहो नैवं शोचितुमर्हसि॥
en: (And again) if you think, O mighty armed, that It (self) constantly take birth and constantly dies, even then you ought not thus to grieve.

sa: इष्टान् भोगान् हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः। तैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः॥
en: Being pleased by the Sacrifice, the celestial will give you your desired enjoyments. Therefore, he who enjoys himself without giving to the givers (celestial) is a thief.

sa: एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः। कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम्॥
en: Knowing this, men of old, desirous of emancipation, performed actions. Therefore, you too perform action, as was done by men of old in olden times.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन। एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात् स्थिति स्थिराम्॥ चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद् दृढम्। तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्॥
en: Arjuna said I cannot see, O destroyer of Madhu, how can this Yoga by, Equanimity, which you have declared to me, be made to have a continual existence. For, O Krishna, mind is fickle, boisterous, perverse and obstinate; and I think to restrain it is as difficult as to restrain the wind.

sa: अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन् मुक्त्वा कलेवरम्। यः प्रयाति स मद्भायंव याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: He, who casts off this body and departs from this world, remembering Me in his last moments. comes to My essence. There is no doubt in it.

sa: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः। अहमादिहि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः॥
en: The hosts of gods and great sages do not know my origin, for I am in every way the source of the gods and sages.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्। पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम्॥
en: Arjuna said You are the supreme Brahma, the supreme asylum, the holiest of the holy, the everlasting divine Being, the first of gods, unborn, the great Lord.

sa: कथं विद्यामहं योगिस्त्वा सदा परिचिन्तयन्। केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन् मय॥
en: O you of mystic powers, how shall I know you by always mediating on you. In what particular entity (manifestation), should l mediate on you?

sa: ततः सर्वाणि सैन्यानि व्यद्रवन्त सुतस्य ते। हतं श्रुतायुधं दृष्ट्वा काम्बोजं च सुदक्षिणम्॥
en: Then beholding Shrutayusha and the prince of the Kambojas slain in battle, all the soldiers of your son's army began to fly in all directions.

sa: संजय उवाच स्थिरो भव महाराज शोकं धारय दुर्धरम्। महान्तं बन्धुनाशं ते कथयिष्यामि तच्छृणु॥
en: Sanjaya said Be patient, O mighty monarch. Bear your unbearable burden of grief. I shall speak of the dreadful carnage of your relations. Now hear be attentively.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते। ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः॥
en: Arjuna said Of those worshipers, who constantly adore you and who mediate on you as Imperishable and Unmanifest, who are the best acquainted with devotion?

sa: त्वं वार्जुनो वा कृष्णो वा भिन्द्यात् प्रद्युम्न एव वा। चक्रव्यूहं महाबाहो पञ्चमो नोपपद्यते॥
en: O mighty-armed one, either you or Arjuna or Krishna or Pradyumna, can penetrate into the circular array. I do not find a fifth man to do it.

sa: अविध्यत् पृथिवीं पार्थः पार्श्वे भीष्मस्य दक्षिणे। उत्पपात ततो धारा वारिणो विमला शुभा॥
en: Penetrated the earth a little to the right of the spot where Bhishma lay. Thereupon, there gushed out a jet of water pure and auspicious,

sa: शिखण्डी तु रणे बाणान् यान् मुमोच महारथः॥ न चक्रुस्ते रुजं तस्य रुक्मपुङ्खाः शिलाशिताः।
en: Those arrows furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone that Shikhandin the mighty car-warrior shot at him could not produce any the slightest pain to him.

sa: स्त्रीत्वं तस्य स्मरन् राजन् सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः। नाजधान रणे भीष्मः स च तन्नाववुद्धवान्॥
en: But, O king, remembering his femininity, Bhishma did not wound him before the eyes of all in that battle. The latter however comprehended it not.

sa: विराटश्च महाराज सैन्धवं वाहिनीपतिः। त्रिंशद्भिर्निशितैर्बाणैराजघान स्तनान्तरे॥ चित्रकार्मुकनिस्त्रिंशो चित्रवर्मायुधध्वजौ। रेजतुश्चित्ररूपौ तौ संग्रामे मत्स्यसैन्धवौ॥ द्रोणः पाञ्चालपुत्रेण समागम्य महारणे। महासमुदयं चक्रे शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ ततो द्रोणो महाराज पार्षतस्य महद् धनुः। छित्त्वा पञ्चाशतेषूणां पार्षतं समविध्यत॥ सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय पार्षतः परवीरहा। द्रोणस्य मिषतो युद्धे प्रेषयामास सायकान्॥
en: Then Virata also that leader of a division, O king, in return pierced the ruler of the Sindhus with thirty sharp arrows between his breast. Then those two kings of the Matsyas and the Sindhus, both of charming appearance and both furnished with beautiful armours, weapons and standards, and both wielding excellent bows and swords, appeared highly resplendent. Then Drona being engaged in that dreadful battle with the son of the Panchala king, fought on fiercely with arrows of close knots.

sa: दुपदः सह पुत्रेण सिद्धार्थेन शिखण्डिना। मुदं च परमां लेभे पाञ्चाल्यः सह बान्धवैः॥
en: And Drupada, the king of Panchalas, became exceedingly joyful, with his son Shikhandin who had obtained his desire and as well as with his friends.

sa: शल्य उवाच यदि मां नाधिगच्छेथा युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः। शपेयं त्वां महाराज पराभावाय वै रणे॥
en: Shalya said If having resolved to fight, O king, you failed to have come to me, I would have then cursed you for brining about your defeat.

sa: शल्य उवाच सम्पत्स्यत्येष ते कामः कुन्तीपुत्र यथेप्सितम्। गच्छ युध्यस्व विश्रब्धः प्रतिजाने वचस्तव॥
en: Shalya said O Yudhishthira, O son of Kunti, your this desire will be fulfilled. Go, fight as you please. I shall pray for your victory.

sa: को हि नेच्छेत् प्रियं पुत्रं जीवन्तं शाश्वतीः समाः। क्षत्रधर्मं तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य ततस्त्वां नियुनज्म्यहम्॥
en: What person wishes not his dear loved son to live for eternal years? But in view of the duties of Kshatriyas, I do command you to fight.

sa: अयं हि दिवसस्तात यत्र पार्थो महाबलः। जिघांसुः समरे भीष्मं परं यत्नं करिष्यति॥
en: "This indeed is the day, O son, on which the highly powerful son of Pritha desirous of slaying Bhishma in battle, will exert his utmost.

sa: कृते विवाहे तु तदा सा कन्या राजसत्तम! यौवनं समनुप्राप्ता सा च कन्या शिखण्डिनी॥
en: And some time after the wedding had been performed, that daughter, O best of kings, attained her youth; and that daughter, Shikhandin, had also attained her youth.

sa: भीष्म उवाच चकार यत्नं द्रुपदः सुतायाः सर्वकर्मसु। ततो लेख्यादिषु तथा शिल्पेषु च परंतप॥
en: Bhishma said Drupada bestowed all possible care on all the (necessary) accomplishments of his daughter, O vanquisher of foes, teaching her writing, painting and all the arts.

sa: संजय उवाच तं तथा विलपन्तं वै शोकव्याकुलमानसम्। उवाच भगवान् व्यासो युधिष्ठिरमिदं वचः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then the almighty Vyasa addressing Yudhishthira who was thus bewailing and was unmanned by the force of his grief, spoke the following words.

sa: ततो दधार सा देवी गर्भ राजीवलोचना। तां स राजा प्रियां भार्यां दुपदः कुरुनन्दन॥
en: And that goddess, whose eyes resembled the petals on the lotus, continued to hold her fetus. And to that dear wife, O son of Kuru, king Drupada,

sa: अस्मद्वधार्थ निश्चित्य तपो घोरं समास्थितः। ऋते कन्यां महादेव पुत्रो मे स्यादिति ब्रुवन्॥
en: Resolving to bring about my destruction, he took to the severest penances, and said “Let mine be a son, and not a daughter, 0 Mahadeva;

sa: हनिष्यासि रणे भीष्मं पुरुषत्वं च लप्स्यसे। स्मरिष्यसि च तत् सर्वं देहमन्यं गता सती॥
en: You will slay Bhishma in battle, for you will attain the state of a man. And you will recollect all this, when you go to another body.

sa: अद्य चापि महत् कर्म प्रकरिष्ये महाबल। अहं वाद्य हतः शेष्ये हनिष्ये वाऽद्य पाण्डवान्॥
en: This day, O highly puissant hero, I shall perform a marvelous feat. Either slain I shall lie on the field, or I will today slay the Pandavas.

sa: संजय उवाच आचक्षे ते महाराज यदकार्षीत् पिता तव। पीडिते तव पुत्रस्य सैन्ये पाण्डवसुंजयैः॥
en: Sanjaya said I shall tell you, O monarch, what did your father do, when the troops of your sons were afflicted by the Pandavas and the Srinjayas.

sa: न हि मां क्षत्रियः कश्चिद् वीर्येण व्यजयद् युधि। ऋते ब्रह्मविदस्तात तपसा संशितव्रतात्॥
en: No Kshatriya has ever by mere prowess vanquished me in battle, except one acquainted with Brahma, O my son and observant of vows and austerities.

sa: एषा मे परमा शक्तिरेतन्मे परमं बलम्। यथेष्टं गम्यतां भद्रे किमन्यद् वा करोमि ते॥
en: This (which you have seen) is my highest might, this is greatest strength. Go whiter you like, O blessed lady. What else can I do for you?

sa: संजय उवाच तु ज्ञात्वा ततः पार्धा जग्मुः स्वशिबिरं प्रति। अभिवाद्य महत्मानं भीष्मं कुरुपितामहम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, the sons of Pritha, ascertaining all these things, went back to their own camps, having saluted the high-souled Bhishma the grandsire of the Kurus.

sa: एवं कुरुष्व कौरव्य प्रभाते रथमास्थितः। प्रसुप्तं वा मृतं वेति तुल्यं मन्यामहे वयम्॥
en: Do as we tell you, O son of Kuru, seated on your chariot at day-break. Asleep or dead, We consider it to be the same.

sa: न त्वां रामो रणे जेता जामदग्न्यः कथंचन। त्वमेव समरे रामं विजेता भरतर्षभ॥
en: Rama, the son of Jamadagni, by no means will vanquish you in battle. (Rather), you will vanquish Rama in battle, O best of Bharata's race.

sa: गजो हतः शिरश्छिन्नं मर्म भिन्नं हयो हतः॥ अहतः कोऽपि नैवासीद् भीष्मे निघ्नति शात्रवान्।
en: He, who was killed, had his head cut off, he, who was not killed, was mortally wounded. When Bhishma attacked, there was none who was not wounded.

sa: प्रियो हि पाण्डवो नित्यं भारद्वाजस्य धीमतः। आचार्यश्च रणे नित्यं प्रियः पार्थस्य संजय॥
en: Then son of Pandu is very to the highly intelligent son of Bharadvaja; so also, O Sanjaya, the preceptor always dear to Pritha in battle.

sa: पश्य मे धनुषो वीर्यं पश्य बाह्वोर्बलं मम। एष ते कार्मुकं वीर छिनधि निशितेषुणा॥
en: Behold now the strength of my bow; and behold the might of my arms. O hero, I shall cut asunder this bow of yours by my arrows.

sa: भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वैः सोमकैश्च सकेकयैः। कथं वा धार्मिको भूत्वा त्वमधर्मे मनः कृथाः॥
en: He, being a virtuous man, have you set your mind on a wrong course along with your brothers, and all the Somakas and the Kaikeyas.

sa: राम उवाच प्रेषयिष्यामि भीष्माय कुरुश्रेष्ठाय भाविनि। करिष्यति वचो मह्यं श्रुत्वा च स नराधिपः॥
en: Rama said O beautiful lady, I shall send words to that foremost among the Kurus, Bhishma, and that ruler among men. Hearing them will do, my bidding.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच श्वेते सेनापतौ तात संग्रामे निहते परैः। किमकुर्वन् महेष्वासाः पञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, when their general Shveta was killed by the foe in that battle, what did those great bowmen, the Panchalas and the Pandavas do?

sa: स त्वं पश्य महाभाग योगेश्वर महारथम्। भीष्मः यः शमयेत् शंख्ये दावाग्नि जल्दो यथा।॥
en: O lord of Yoga, search out that great bowman, that mighty car-warriors who will be able to extinguish Bhishma's prowess, as rain charged clouds extinguish a forest-fire.

sa: तद् दृष्ट्वा तावकं सैन्यं विद्रुतं शिबिरं प्रति। मम प्राक्रोशतो राजंस्तथा देवव्रतस्य च॥
en: Beholding this (illusive) your warriors, 0 king, ran towards the encampments, although myself and Devavrata cried at the top of our voice saying, O king,

sa: आशीविषा इव क्रुद्धाः पर्वते गन्धमादने। स तैर्विद्धः स्रवन् रक्तं प्रभिन्न इव कुञ्जरः॥
en: Like infuriate snakes falling upon the mountain Gandhamadana. Pierced with those arrows, and shedding blood copiously like an elephant in rut (shedding the temporal juice),

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच इरावन्तं तु निहतं दृष्ट्वा पार्था महारथाः। संग्रामे किमकुर्वन्त तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Describe to me, O Sanjaya, what the highly puissant sons of Pritha did when they heard that Iravat had been slain in battle,

sa: उष्ट्रवामीभिरप्यन्ये सदश्चैश्च महाजवैः॥ तूर्णं परिययुः सेनां कृत्स्ना कर्णस्य शासनात्। आज्ञापयन्तो राज्ञश्च योग: प्रागुदयादिति॥
en: And others on camels, and others again on good horses went out and ordered the united army at Karna's behest to be ready for battle before sunrise.

sa: हताश्वे स रथे तिष्ठन् भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्। शक्तिं चिक्षेप तरसा गाङ्गेयस्य रं प्रति॥
en: The greatly strong Bhima however stood on the car, the horses of which were killed. He then with great force hurled a dart at Bhishma.

sa: शकटस्य तु राजेन्द्र भारद्वाजो मुखे स्थितः। अनु तस्याभवद् भोजो जुगोपैनं ततः स्वयम्॥
en: The son of Bharadvaja, himself stood at the mouth of the Sakata. Next to him stood the ruler of the Bhojas, who protected the former.

sa: स्ववीर्यं यः समाश्रित्य समाह्वयति वै परान्। अभीतो युध्यते शत्रून् स वै पुरुष उच्यते॥
en: He, who, relying on his own prowess challenges his enemies to fight and fights with them without being struck with fear, is said to be a man.

sa: वध्यमानं तु ततं सैन्यं द्रोणेन निशितैः शरैः। व्यभ्रमतं तत्र तत्रैव क्षोभ्यमाण इवार्णवः॥
en: That army, then thus slaughter by Drona with his keen pointed arrows begin to whirl about,, like the agitated sea, on the filed of battle.

sa: यतो यतः प्रेक्षते स्म गदामुद्यम्य पाण्डवः। तेन तेन स्म दीर्यन्ते सर्वसैन्यानि भारत॥
en: Uplifting his mace, in whichever direction the son of Pandu turned his eyes 0 Bharata, from that direction, all the soldiers fled (deserting their ranks).

sa: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वा मुनयोऽप्सरसोऽपि च। कथां तां ब्रह्मणा गीतां श्रुत्वा प्रीता दिवं ययुः॥
en: as Thereafter the celestials, together with the Gandharvas, the sages, and the Apsaras, having listened to that discourse delivered by Brahma, went to Heaven with joyful hearts.

sa: अपरे दन्तवेष्टेषु कुम्भेषु च कटेषु च। शरैः समर्पिता नागाः क्रोञ्चवद् व्यन्दन् मुहुः॥
en: Other elephants pierced with long shafts in the jaw of frontal globes or temples, began to utter yelling cries resembling the screech of the cranes.

sa: संजय उवाच व्युषितायां तु शर्वर्यामुदिते च दिवाकरे। उभे सेने महाराज युद्धायैव समीयतुः॥
en: Sanjaya said When that night had passed away and when the sun had risen, the two armies O mighty monarch, encountered each other for battle.

sa: ततः सीतां शिरःस्नातां संयुक्तां प्रतिकर्मणा। महाभिरणोपेतां महार्हाम्बरधारिणीम्॥ आरोग्य शिबिकां सीतां राक्षसैर्वहनोचितैः। राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्गुप्तामाजहार विभीषणः॥
en: Thereupon placing Sta, bathed, performing the due rites wearing valuable clothes and adorned with valuable ornaments, palanquin, carried by many a capable Rākşasa, brought her (to Rama).

sa: क्वचिद् भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान् क्वचित् पानं विभागतः।।२८ । क्वचिदर्धावशेषाणि पश्यन् वै विचचार ह।
en: And (at some spots) he saw various kinds of viands, and at other wines ranged in rows, and at others the wine-vessels remaining half full.

sa: अन्विष्य रक्षसां लङ्का कुर्याद् रामः सलक्ष्मणः। नहि ताभ्यां रिपुर्दृष्टो मुहूर्तमपि जीवति ॥
en: Instituting enquiries, along with Lakṣmaṇa, he shall soon reduce Lankā to this plight. And observed by them the enemy shall not live for a moment.

sa: कामं हन्तुं समर्थोऽस्मि सहस्राण्यपि रक्षसाम्। न तु शक्ष्याम्यहं प्राप्तुं परं पारं महोदधेः॥
en: I am capable of destroying thousands of Rākşasas, but I shall not then be able to get at the other shore of the great ocean.

sa: पुत्रः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः। धरान्तरं गतः शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः॥
en: That crow, best of birds, was the son of the lord of the celestials in disguise. And gifted with air-like velocity, he speedily entered inside the earth.

sa: यथा तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं गात्रैः शोकाभिकर्शितैः। संस्पृशेयं सकामाहं तथा कुरु दयां मयि ॥
en: Do you so dispense your kindness to me that, with my desire attained, I may touch that tigerlike one with my body reduced by grief.

sa: यदि तावत् त्वमिन्द्रेण प्रेषितो रावणालयम्। तत्त्वमाख्याहि मा ते भूद् भयं वानर मोक्ष्यसे॥
en: If you had been sent to Rāvana's residence by Indra, tell us truly everything. Let no fear, O imonkey, be yours. You shall be liberated.

sa: तानुवाच हरिश्रेष्ठो हनूमान् वानरर्षभः। अव्यग्रमनसो यूयं मधु सेवत वानराः॥ अहमावर्जयिष्यामि युष्माकं परिपन्थिनः।
en: Thereupon Hanumān, the foremost of the monkeys, spoke to them, saying.-"O monkeys, do youundisturbed drink honey. I shall myself thwart them who will obstruct you."

sa: बलैस्तु संकुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः। मां नयेद् यदि काकुत्स्थस्तत् तस्य सदृशं भवेत्॥
en: Truly it shall be his becoming work, if Kākutstha, the repressor of enemy's host, can take me away, enveloping the city Lankā with his army.

sa: अबद्ध्वा सागरे सेतुं घोरे च वरुणालये। लङ्का न मर्दितुं शक्या सेन्ट्रैरपि सुरासुरैः॥
en: Without throwing a bridge over the ocean-the dread abode of Varuņa-even the Asuras and celestials with Indra (at their head) are unequal to subduing Laňkā.

sa: किं नाम तौ मानुषराजपुत्रावस्माकमेकेन हि राक्षसेन। सुप्राकृतेनापि निहन्तुमेतौ शक्यौ कुतो भीषयसे स्म भीरो॥
en: Why are you O timid one, afraid of them since any one of these Rākṣasas is capable of slaying those two princes, human beings as they are?

sa: सागरस्येव मे वेगो मारुतस्येव मे बलम्। न च दाशरथिर्वेद तेन मां योद्भुमिच्छति॥
en: My impetuosity like the Ocean's, my strength like the Wind's, Dācarathi does not know, and therefore it is that he desire to fight with me.

sa: यस्तु भीमा प्रवल्गन्ती चमूं तिष्ठति शोभयन्। स्थितां तीरे समुद्रस्य द्वितीय इव सागरः॥ एष दर्दुरसंकाशो विनतो नाम यूथपः। पिबंश्चरति यौ वेणां नदीनामुत्तमा नदीम्॥ षष्टिः शतसहस्राणि बलमस्य प्लवंगमाः।
en: He that stay gracing the dreadful array overflowing with talk, stationed on the shore of the ocean, resembling a second sea and like to Durdara*-is the leader named Vinată. And he range, drinking of the waters of) the Veņa, best among streams-and his forces are sixty lacs of monkeys. *Name os a celebrated monkeys-leader.

sa: सा त्वां सुप्तं हतं ज्ञात्वा मां च रक्षोगृहं गताम्। हृदयेनावदीर्णेन न भविष्यति राघव॥
en: O Raghava, hearing you slain while asleep, and me staying in the abode of the Rākşasa, she with her heart cleft (in twain), shall cease to exist.

sa: शोकस्ते विगतः सर्वकल्याणं त्वामुपस्थितम्। ध्रुवं त्वां भजते लक्ष्मीः प्रियं ते भवति शृणु॥
en: All your sorrow has departed, and your good day has dawned. Certainly Laksmi seek you. And, O lady, hearken to what is dear to you!

sa: तत्र तत्र च संनद्धाः संपतन्ति सहस्रशः। आपूर्यन्ते राजमार्गाः सैन्येरद्भुतदर्शनैः॥ वेगवद्भिर्नदद्भिश्च तोयौघैरिव सागरः।
en: As waters fill up the ocean, mailed warriors of wonderful forms, vehement and roaring, by thousands rush out on all aides and fill the highways.

sa: केशाः सूक्ष्माः समा नीला ध्रुवौ चासंहते मम। वृत्ते चारोमके जो दन्ताश्चाविरला मम।।।।
en: My hairs are fine, equal, and blue; my eyebrows touch each other; my hips are devoid of down and round; and my teeth are close.

sa: कथं वक्ष्यामि शत्रुघ्नं भरतं च यशस्विनम्। मया सह वनं यातो विना तेनाहमागतः॥
en: How shall I say to Satrughna and the illustrious Bharata, 'He went with me to the forest; but I come (back) here without him "?

sa: स तूत्पातांस्ततो दृष्ट्वा राक्षसानां भयावहान्। प्रादुर्भूतान्सुघोरांश्च धूम्राक्षो व्यथितोऽभवत्।। मुमुहू राक्षसाः सर्वे धूम्राक्षस्य पुरःसराः॥
en: And witnessing those dreadful inauspicious omens at the outset, fraught with fear to the Räkşasas, Dhūmrākṣa was greatly aggrieved; and the Räksaşas marching before him, were stupefied.

sa: स तेन शैलेन भृशं रराज शैलोपमो गन्धवाहत्मजस्तु। सहस्रधारेण सपावकेन चक्रेण खे विष्णुरिवार्पितेन॥
en: With that mountain, the offspring of the bearer of perfumes appeared surpassingly grand, like very Vişņu equipped with the flaming discus having a thousand edges.

sa: ततो महात्मा निपपात तस्मिन् शैलोत्तये वानरसैन्यमध्ये। हर्युत्तमेभ्यः शिरसाभिवाद्य विभीषणं तत्र च सस्वजे सः॥
en: Then the high-souled one dropped on that best of mountains in the midst of the monkey-forces; and, bowing down to the principal monkeys there, he embraced Vibhisana.

sa: स एष किल सैन्येन प्राप्तः किल निकुम्भिलाम्। यद्युत्तिष्ठेत्कृतं कर्म हतान्सर्वांश्च विद्धि नः॥
en: Now he with his army has gone to Nikumbhilā; and when, having finished his rites, he gets up, know that all of us are slain.

sa: यदि ते प्रथमे युद्धे न दृष्टो मत्पराक्रमः। अद्य त्वां दर्शयिष्यामि तिष्ठेदानी व्यवस्थितः॥
en: If at the first encounter you have not witnessed my prowess, today shall I show it to you. Do you now stay, summoning your attention.

sa: तमसा बहुलेनेमाः संसक्ताः सर्वतो दिश:। नेह विज्ञायते स्वो वा परो वा राक्षसोतमाः।।।।
en: All sides are entirely enveloped in this gioom, so that, O foremost of Raksasas, here we dysiot know who belong to us and who not.

sa: किं नु राज्येन दुर्धर्ष लक्ष्मणेन विना मम। कथं वक्ष्याम्यहं त्वम्बां सुमित्रां पुत्रवत्सलाम्॥
en: What, О irrepressible one, shall I do with the kingdom without my Lakşmaņa? And what shall I say to mother Sumitra, fond of her son?

sa: हा भ्रातर्मनुजश्रेष्ठ शूराणां प्रवर प्रभो॥ एकाकी किं नु मां त्यक्वा परलोकाय गच्छसि।
en: Ah, my brother! You best of me! O master, who were the foremost of heroes! Why, forsaking me, did you repair to the other regions.

sa: रथेन मम भूमिष्ठं शीघ्रं याहि रघूत्तमम्। आहूय भूतलं यातः कुरु देवहितं महत्॥
en: Taking my car, hie to the best of the Raghus. And reaching the earth do you welcoming (him) bring about great good to the gods.

sa: तवापि मे प्रियं कार्यं त्वत्प्रभावान्मया जितम्।१७।। अवश्यं तु क्षमं वाच्यो मया त्वं राक्षसेश्वर।
en: It behove me to encompass your welfare since by your help I have gained the victory. I lord of Räkșasas, forsooth, you should hear my wellmeaning words.

sa: न तथास्मि महाबाहो यथा मामवगच्छसि। प्रत्ययं गच्छ मे स्वेन चारित्रेणैव ते शपे॥
en: O you of long arms, I am not what you have taken me to be. Do you believe me-I do swear by my own character.

sa: विमानं प्रेक्ष्य सुग्रीवं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह। ब्रूहि वानरशार्दूल सर्वान्वानरपुङ्गवान्॥ स्त्रीभिः परिवृताः सर्वे ह्ययोध्यां यान्तु सीतया। तथा त्वमेभिः सर्वाभिः स्त्रीभिः सह महाबल।२८।। अभित्वरय सुग्रीव गच्छामः प्लवगाधिप।
en: O foremost of monkeys, do you speak to all the leading monkeys that they may go to Ayodhyā accompanied by their wives. O you of great strength they may all go with Sīta. Do you hurry them on, O Sugrīva. We shall (soon) go, O you the lord of monkeys.

sa: विमानं प्रेक्ष्य सुग्रीवं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह। ब्रूहि वानरशार्दूल सर्वान्वानरपुङ्गवान्॥ स्त्रीभिः परिवृताः सर्वे ह्ययोध्यां यान्तु सीतया। तथा त्वमेभिः सर्वाभिः स्त्रीभिः सह महाबल।२८।। अभित्वरय सुग्रीव गच्छामः प्लवगाधिप।
en: O foremost of monkeys, do you speak to all the leading monkeys that they may go to Ayodhyā accompanied by their wives. O you of great strength they may all go with Sīta. Do you hurry them on, O Sugrīva. We shall (soon) go, O you the lord of monkeys.

sa: एतच्छुत्वा यमाकारं भजते भरतस्ततः। स च ते वेदितव्यः स्यात्सर्वं यच्चापि मां प्रति॥
en: You should read the signs expressive of joy or asas sorrow that Bharata shall display on hearing this and infer therefrom his attitude towards me.

sa: शक्रोऽपि विजितस्तेन कथं लब्धवरश्च सः। कथं च बलवानन्पुत्रो न पिता तस्य रावणः॥
en: How was Śakra vanquished by him, and how also did he obtain the boon? And how was the son powerful and not his sire Rāvaņa.

sa: स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामः सर्व एव यथागतम्। कृतकृत्या वयं तात दत्त्वा तव वरद्वयम्॥
en: Good betide you! We shall (now) go whither we had come, having, my child, done my duty and bestowed on you the couple of boons.

sa: अवध्या मम ते देवाः सुकेशतनया रणे। मन्त्रं तु वः प्रदास्यामि यस्तान्वै निहनिष्यति॥
en: You gods, Sukesa's sons are incapable of being slain by me in battle. But I shall tell you the means whereby they may be slain.

sa: एवमुक्तं तु तद्रक्षो विनीतमिदमब्रवीत्॥ अहं पौलस्त्यतनयो दशग्रीवश्च नामतः। मुनेर्विश्रवसो यस्तु तृतीयो ब्रह्मणोऽभवत्॥
en: Thus addressed, the Rākşasas humbly said, 'Ten-necked by name, I am the son of ascetic, Paulastya, who was born as the third son of Brahmā.

sa: बलं मम न खल्वेतन्मर्यादैषा निसर्गतः। स दृष्टो न मया काल मुहूर्तमपि जीवति॥
en: Verily this is not mine strength, this might pertain to me by nature. O Time, if seen by me, he won't live for a moment.

sa: एवमुक्त्वाथ प्रोवाच राक्षसं दानवेश्वरः। यदेतद् दृश्यते वीर चक्रं दीप्तानलोपमम्॥ एतद्गृहीत्वा गच्छ त्वं मम पार्श्व महाबल। ततोऽहं तव व्याख्यास्ये मुक्तिकारणमव्ययम्॥ तत्कुरुष्व महाबाहो सा विलम्बस्व रावण। एतच्छ्रुत्वा गतो रक्षः प्रहसंश्च महाबलः॥ यत्र स्थितं महादिव्यं कुण्डलं रघुनन्दन। लीलयोत्पाटनं चक्रे रावणो बलदर्पितः॥ न च चालयितुं शक्तो रावणोऽभूत्कथंचन। लज्जया स पुनर्भूयो यत्नं चक्रे महाबलः॥
en: Having said this the lord of Dānavas again spoke to the lord of Rākşasa-'O hero, O you gifted with great strength, take that flaming discus which you behold and come to my side. I shall then relate to you the means of eternal liberation. Do what I have told you, O you having long arms. Delay not O Rāvana." Hearing this the highly powerful Raksasa proceeded, laughing, O descendant of Raghu where that celestial kundala was. Rāvana, proud of his prowess, easily took it up but could not move it by any means. And being ashamed that highly powerful one again attempted.

sa: शप्तः स्त्रीभिः स तु समं हतौजा इव निष्प्रभः॥ पतिव्रताभिः साध्वीभिर्बभूव विमना इव।
en: Being thus imprecated by those chaste females, devoted to their husbands, he became shorn of energy and effulgence and appeared like one divested of mind.

sa: आगच्छ तात गच्छामो रणकर्म निवर्तताम्। जितं नो विदितं तेऽस्तु स्वस्थो भव गतज्वरः।।३३
en: Do you come, O father, our work in the battle field is finished; know, we have achieved victory; be you consoled and divested of agonies.

sa: राक्षसेन्द्र गतो बाली यस्ते प्रतिबलो भवेत्। कोऽन्यः प्रमुखतः स्थातुं तव शक्तः प्लवंगमः॥
en: O lord of Rākşasas, he is not present here, who shall be able to withstand you. What monkey else is capable of standing before you?

sa: कथं नारद जायन्ते तस्मिन्द्वीपे महाबलाः। श्वेतद्वीपे कथं वासः प्राप्तस्तैस्तु महात्मभिः॥ एतन्मे सर्वमाख्याहि प्रभो नारद तत्त्वतः। त्वया दृष्टं जगत्सर्वं हस्तामलकवत्सदा॥ रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नारदः प्रत्युवाच ह। अनन्यमनसो नित्यं नारायणपरायणाः॥ तदाराधनसक्ताच तचित्तास्तत्परायणाः। एकान्तभावानुगतास्ते जरा राक्षसाधिप॥ तचित्तास्तद्रतप्राणा नरा नारायणं सदा। श्वेतद्वीपे तु तैर्वास अर्जितः सुमहात्मभिः॥ ये हता लोकनाथेन शाईमानम्य संयुगे। चक्रायुधेन देवेन तेषां वासस्त्रिविष्टपे॥ नहि यज्ञफलैस्तात न तपोभिन संयमै
en: “O celestial saint, why are the inhabitants of Svetadvipa powerful? And how did those highsouled ones come to live there? O lord, do you relate to me everything at length. You do observe the whole universe like a myrobalam in your palms." Hearing the words of Ravana, the celestial saint said:-"o lord of Raksasas, the inhabitants of Svetadvipa are perpetually devoted to Nārāyaņa with whole-mindedness and earnestly worship Him. They have always their hearts and minds devoted to Him and are all high-souled. Having rendered their lives and souls to Nārāyaṇa, they have been blessed with their abode in Svetadvſpa. Those, who are slain in the encounter with his bow bent by Vişnu— the holder of discuss and the preserver of the world, attain to the celestial region. Neither by sacrifice, devout pen

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच श्रुतं मे सूत कात्स्न्र्येन कर्म पार्थस्यधीमतः। कच्चित् तवापि विदितं याथातथ्येन सारथे॥
en: Dhritarashtra said : O charioteer, O Suta, do you know in detail the acts of the wise Arjuna which I have heard from the beginning to end?

sa: नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणः पूर्वे मया स्वेन बलेन च। वैचित्रवीर्यके क्षेत्रे जातः स सुमहामतिः॥
en: At the command of the grandfather and through my own energy, the highly intelligent Vidura was procreated by me upon a soil owned by Vichitravirya.

sa: नालं सुखाय सुहृदो नालं दुःखाय शत्रवः। न च प्रज्ञालमर्थानां न सुखानामलं धनम्॥
en: Friends are not the root of one's happiness. Enemies are not the root of one's misery. Wisdom cannot bring on wealth; wealth cannot give happiness.

sa: यदा न कुरुते धीरः सर्वभूतेषु पापकम्। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा॥
en: When a person does no wrong to any creature, in thought, word, or deed, he is then said to attain to a state of Brahma.

sa: देवदूत उवाच आनुपूर्वेण पिण्डानां प्रविभागः पृथक् पृथक्॥ पितॄणां त्रिषु सर्वेषां निरुक्तं कथितं त्वया।
en: The Celestial Messenger said You have explained the division of the ricc balls and their consignment one after another to the three, together with the reasons thereof.

sa: न तु युक्तं रणे हन्तुं दिव्यैरस्त्रैः पृथग्जनम्। आर्जवेनैव युद्धेन विजेष्यामो वयं परान्॥
en: It is not, however, proper to annihilate in a battle, by means of celestial weapons ordinary men. We will by artless fighting vanquish our foes.

sa: इत्युक्तः स तथेत्युक्त्वा पूजयामास तं हयम्। फाल्गुनं च युधि श्रेष्ठं विधिवत् सहदेवजः॥
en: Thus addressed by him, the son of Sahadeva said, So be it, and then duly adored that horse as also Phalguna, that foremost of warriors.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कुत: सृष्टमिदं विश्वं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम्। प्रलये च कमभ्येति तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Whence has this universe, consisting of mobile and immobile creatures, originated? Whom does it go to when it is destroyed? Tell me this, O grandfather.

sa: शिष्टाचारे मनः कृत्वा प्रतिष्ठाप्य च सर्वशः। यामयं लभते वृत्तिं सा न शक्या हतोऽन्यथा॥
en: Once can wholly obtain credit by directing the heart towards virtuous behaviours. This he gains only be practising the above four; Otherwise to gain this becomes impossible.

sa: ममैव त्वं तवैवाहं ये मदीयास्तवैव ते। यस्त्वां द्वेष्टि स मां द्वेष्टि यस्त्वामनु समामनु॥
en: You are mine and I am yours. All that is mine is yours also. He who hates you hates me and he who follows you follows me.

sa: एते भावा जगत् सर्वं वहन्ति सचराचरम्। श्रिता विरजसं देवं यमाहुः प्रकृतेः परम्॥
en: These existence's, resting upon the supreme Divinity that is above Prakriti and that is inactive, uphold the entire universe of the mobile and immobile objects.

sa: तमृषयः ऊचुः परमं लोमहर्षणे वक्ष्यामस्त्वां नः प्रतिवक्ष्यसि वचः शुश्रूषतां कथायोगं न: कथायोगे॥
en: The Rishis replied, "O son of Lomaharshana, we shall ask you and you will relate to us, who are anxious to hear, some excellent stories.

sa: कच्चिन्मानं तात लभन्त एते धनुर्भूतः कच्चिदेतेऽप्यरोगाः। येषां राष्ट्रे निवसति दर्शनीयो महेष्वासः शीलवान् द्रोणपुत्रः॥
en: Do these wielders of the bow get honours? Are they without disease in whose kingdom worth seeing lives the well-behaved son of Drona endued with great qualities?

sa: यस्य स्म ददतो वित्तं न कदाचन हीयते। तं बलिं नाधिगच्छामि ब्रह्मन्नाचक्ष्व मे बलिम्॥
en: Tell me, O Brahman, where may I now find that Vali whose wealth continued undiminished even though he used to distribute it as largely as he wished.

sa: सवर्णो हि सवर्णानां पशुसंज्ञां करिष्यसि। कोऽन्य एव यथा हि त्वं जरासंध वृथामतिः॥
en: You are calling all men belonging to your own orders as beasts. O Jarasandha, foolish as you are, who else is capable of doing it?

sa: कर्णं द्रक्ष्यति कुन्ती च सौभद्रं चापि यादवी। द्रौपदी पञ्च पुत्रांश्च पितॄन् भ्रातूंस्तथैव च॥
en: Kunti also shall see Karna, and she of Yadu's race shall see her son Abhimanyu. Draupadi shall see her five sons, her fathers and her brothers also.

sa: स तानभ्यर्च्य मेधावी पृष्ट्वा च कुशलं तदा। अभ्यवादयत प्रीतः पितरं मातरं तदा॥
en: Gifted with great intelligence, he honoured them in return and enquired after their wellbeing. With a pleased heart he then saluted his father and mother.

sa: धौम्य उवाच आनर्तेषु प्रतीच्यां वै कीर्तयिष्यामि ते दिशि। यानि तत्र पवित्राणि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च॥
en: Dhaumya said : I shall (now) describe to you those sacred spots capable of producing merit that lie on the west, in the country of the Anartas.

sa: कुन्ती उवाच एवमेतन्महाबाहो यथा वदसि पाण्डवा कृतमुद्धर्षणं पूर्वं मया वः सीदतां नृपाः॥
en: Kunti said-What you say, O mighty-armed son of Pandu, is indeed, true! O kings, formerly, when you were all dispirited, indeed, I cxcited you all.

sa: कथं पाण्डोर्न नश्येत संततिः पुरुषर्षभाः। यशश्च वो न नश्येत इति चोद्धर्षणं कृतम्॥
en: O foremost of men, I encouraged you so that the sons of Pandu might not be lost, so that their fame might not be lost.

sa: शक्रं मृगय शीघ्रं त्वं भक्तायाः कुरु मे दयाम्। बाढमित्येव भगवान् बृहस्पतिरुवाच ताम्॥
en: Be quick in hunting out Indra and do me who am devoted to you, a favour and the god Brihaspati said to her-"Be it so."

sa: धनंजयं च मे शंस यद् यच्चक्रे रथर्षभः। तस्माद् भयं नो भूयिष्ठं भ्रातृव्याच्च वृकोदरात्॥
en: Tell me also what that foremost of carwarriors, namely, Dhananjaya, did? We are much afraid of him and of his brother, Vrikodara, who is our (implacable) enemy.

sa: एता वाचः शुभाः शृण्वन् सुहृदां भरतर्षभ॥ प्रविवेश पुरं हृष्टः स्ववेश्म च नराधिपः।
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, hearing such pleasing words from the friends, that ruler of men (Duryodhana) cheerfully entered the city and his iron palace.

sa: त्वां चापि श्रेयसा योक्ष्ये न चिराद् भरतर्षभ। संशयच्छेदनार्थाय प्राप्तं मां विद्धि पुत्रका॥
en: O chief of Bharata's race, I shall unite you also with great benefit. Know, O son, that I am come here for removing your doubts.

sa: क्षत्रियः क्षत्रियं जित्वा रणे रणकृतां वरः। यो मुञ्चति वशे कृत्वा गुरुर्भवति तस्य सः॥
en: That chief of warriors in the Kshatriya race, who, having overcome a Kshatriya in battle and brought him under his power, sets him free, becomes his preceptor.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा सुदुःखार्तो जीवितात् स व्यमुच्यत। मृगः पाण्डुश्च दुःखार्तः क्षणेन समपद्यत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this, the deer, affected with grief, gave up his life; and Pandu also was plunged in grief in a moment.

sa: पर्वत उवाच ग्रामे चाधिकृतः सोऽस्तु खरयानेन गच्छतु। शुनः कर्षतु वृत्त्यर्थे यस्ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: Parvata said Let him who has stolen your stalks be the head of a village. Let him make journeys on asses. Let him leash hounds for maintenance.

sa: विष्वक्सेनो यस्य यन्ता यस्य योद्धा धनंजयः। अशक्यः स रथो जेतुं मन्ये देवासुरैरपि॥
en: consider that chariot which has Vishvaksena for its driver and Dhananjaya for its warrior, to be unconquerable even be the celestials and Asuras united together.

sa: असिं दृष्ट्वा तथा च्छिन्नं प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्॥ प्राहिणोत् सहदेवाय सा मोघा न्यपतद् भुवि।
en: Beholding his sword cut in two parts Shakuni took up a dreadful mace and discharged it at Sahadeva. That mace also dropped down on the earth unsuccessful.

sa: त्वामेवाहुः परं बीजं निधानं सर्वसम्पदाम। त्वया नाथेन देवेश सर्वापद्भ्यो भयं न हि॥
en: They call you the supreme germ and the depository of all wealth; O king of gods, being protected by you all will lose their terrors.

sa: एते कौरव संक्रन्दे शैनेयं पर्यवाकिरन्। दृष्ट्वा न समरे द्रोणं निघ्नन्तं पाण्डवी चमूम्॥
en: Those hosts of the Kurus together with those warriors, began to shower arrows on the grandson of Shini. Then beholding Drona slaughter the Pandava hosts.

sa: यन्न दात्प्रहस्तो वा नेन्द्रजिन्नापरे जनाः। न कुम्भकर्णोऽतिरथो नातिकायो नरान्तकः। न स्वयं बहु मन्येथास्तस्योदर्कोऽयमागतः॥
en: Prahasta, Indrajit Kumbhakarma, Atikāya, Atiratha, Narāntaka, yourself and others-none of you paid heed, out of haughtiness, to what I had said which has now been brought about.

sa: इन्द्रियग्राम इत्येष मन एकादशं भवेत्। एतं ग्रामं जयेत् पूर्वं ततो ब्रह्म प्रकाशते॥
en: These form the group of organs, with mind numbering as the eleventh. One should first subdue this group. Then will Brahma shine forth (in him).

sa: उन्मर्यादे प्रवृत्ते तु दस्युभिः संकरे कृते। सर्वे वर्णा न दुष्येयुः शस्त्रवन्तो युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: When robbers overcoming all restraints, lay waste the country, all the orders may take up arms. By doing so, they commit no sin, O Yudhishthira!'

sa: नास्ति सत्यसमो धर्मो न सत्याद् विद्यते परम्। न हि तीव्रतरं किंचिदनृतादिह विद्यते॥
en: There is no virtue equal to truth, there is nothing (in this world) superior to truth. And there is nothing (again) more sinful than falsehood.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अथ तात यदा सर्वाः शस्त्रमाददते प्रजाः। व्युत्नामन्ति स्वधर्मेभ्यः क्षत्रस्य क्षीयते बलम्॥ राजा त्राता तु लोकस्य कथं च स्यात् परायणम्। एतन्मे संशयं ब्रूहि विस्तरेण नराधिप॥
en: “When, O sire, giving up their respective duties, all the castes take up arms against the king, then, of course, the power of the king suffers decrease. How would the king then become the protector and refuge of the people? Remove this doubt of mine, O king, by speaking to me fully." Bhishma said

sa: मत्समो हि गदायुद्धे पृथिव्यां नास्ति कश्चन। नासीत् कश्चिदतिक्रान्तो भवति न च कश्चन॥
en: My equal in a fight with the mace, there is none in the world; there has been none my equal, nor will there be any.

sa: श्येन उवाच धर्मात्मानं त्वाहुरेकं सर्वे राजन् महीक्षितः। सर्वधर्मविरुद्धं त्वं कस्मात् कर्म चिकीर्षसि॥
en: The Hawk said: All the kings of earth call you virtuous. Therefore why do you perform an act which is not in accordance with Dharma?

sa: इदं मे वचनं श्रुत्वा भर्तुरन्वेषणो त्वर। देवतानां यथा वाच्यो न भवेयं तथा कुरु॥
en: Hearing these my words do you speedily go in search of a husband. Act in such a way that we may not be blamed by the gods.

sa: आत्मकामा सदा चण्डी क्रोधना प्राज्ञमानिनी। अरोगा चापि मे माता कैकेयी किमुवाच ह॥
en: And that wrathful one ever intent on her interest and setting immense store by her wisdom, my mother Kaikeyī, is it also well with her?

sa: सममेष्यसि दारैस्त्वं मा स्म शोके मनः कृथाः। राज्येन तनयाभ्यां च सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: I tell you the truth that you shall find your wife, son and daughter and also obtain your kingdom back and so be not filled with grief.

sa: राज्यप्राप्तिं च सम्प्राप्त ज्येष्ठं पाण्डुसुतं तदा। कथयन्ति स्म सम्भूय चत्वरेषु सभासु च॥
en: Assembling in court-yards and in other places of meeting, they talked of the eldest son of Pandu as the person fit for governing the kingdom.

sa: परित्यक्तुं न शक्तोऽस्मि दानशक्तिश्च नास्ति मे। कथमत्र मया कार्यं तद् ब्रूहि भगवन् मम॥
en: I cannot forsake them, but I have no power to provide them with their sustenance. O exalted one, tell me what should be now done by me.

sa: तत्र गत्वा स जग्राह गदां शङ्ख च भारत। स्फाटिकं च सभाद्रव्यं यदासीद् वृषपर्वणः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, going there he (Maya) brought the club, the conch shall and the various articles of crystal which belonged to Vrishaparva, (the Danava king).

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच धर्मान्तरं प्रति कथां कथ्यमानां मया नृप। सर्वपापहरां नित्यं शृणुष्वावहितो मम॥
en: Markandeya said: O king, I shall now speak on another sacred subject relating to eternity which destroys all sins. Listen to me with all others.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततोऽस्य पाणिना राजन् जलशीतेन पाण्डवः। उरो मुखं च शनकैः पर्यमार्जत धर्मवित्॥
en: Vaishampayana said The Pandava king, knowing every duty, using his own hand, then softly rubbed with cold water the breast and the face of the old king.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यस्य नागसहस्रेण शतसंख्येन वै बलम्। सोऽयं नारी व्यपाश्रित्य शेते राजा गतासुवत्॥
en: on me am Yudhishthira said Alas, he whose strength was equal to that of a hundred thousand elephants, alas, that king sits today, learning on a woman.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच यत् त्वमिच्छसि राजेन्द्र दानधर्मं युधिष्ठिर। इष्टं चेदं सदा मह्यं राजन् गौरवतस्तथा॥
en: Markandeya said : O king of kings, O Yudhishthira, O monarch, the rules of charity which you desire to hear from me are highly valued by him.

sa: न त्वां प्रव्यथयेद् दुःखं प्रीतिर्वा न प्रहर्षयेत्। सम्मतश्चापि वृद्धानां तांश्च पृच्छसि संशयान्॥
en: Pain does not afflict you, nor does pleasure exhilarate. Yourself the exemplar of even aged people, you refer to them on doubtful point (of morality).

sa: अभिज्ञौ युद्धधर्मस्य मम माता पिता च मे॥ तौ हि संजय दुःखार्ती विज्ञाप्यौ वचनाद्धि मे। इष्टं भृत्या भृताः सम्यग् भूः प्रशास्ता ससागरा॥ मूर्ध्नि स्थितममित्राणां जीवतामेव संजय।
en: My parents are not ignorant of the rules of warfare. As directed by me, O Sanjaya, tell them that are afflicted with grief these words: I have celebrated sacrifices, maintained a large number of servants properly governed the whole Earth with her seas, I stood on the heads of my living enemies.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा स तु धर्मात्मा वृद्धो राजा कुरुद्वहः। गान्धारी शिश्रिये धीमान् सहसैव गतासुवत्॥
en: Having said so, that perpetuator of Kuru's race, viz., the pious old king, blessed with prosperity, leaned to Gandhari and suddenly looked like one dcad.

sa: एवं दत्त्वा वरान् देवो मम देवी च भारत। अन्तर्हितः क्षणे तस्मिन् सगणो भीमपूर्वज॥
en: Vasudeva continued Having thus granted me boons both the god and the goddess, O Bharata, disappeared there and then with their associates, O elder brother of Bhima.

sa: शक्यो धारयितुं कामो भवेदभ्यागतो मया। यदि भूयो वसन्तो मां न हन्यात् पुष्पितगुमः॥
en: Had I not been overpowered by this season of spring with blossoming trees, I would have been able to put up with the presentamorous infliction.

sa: यदि मे सहते गन्धं रूपं वेषं तथा वपुः। अद्यैव गर्भ कौसल्या विशिष्टं प्रतिपद्यताम्॥
en: If the princess of Kosalya (Ambika) can bear my strong odour, my ugly and grim visage, my attire and body, she will then conceive an excellent son.

sa: तत: संतापिता लोका मत्प्रसूतेन तेजसा। क्षणेन हि दिशः खं च सर्वतो हि विदीपितम्॥
en: Then on account of the energy of that weapon discharged by me, all the world became oppressed and all the points and the firmament became suddenly illuminated.

sa: कस्य प्रसादाद् दारांश्च पुत्रांश्चैव गृहाणि च। इतो निवृत्ताः पश्येम सिद्धार्थाः सुखिनो वयम्॥
en: By whose favour shall we, crowned with success and rendered happy, returning from this place, shall behold our wives and our son, and our homes?

sa: किं त्वं साक्षाद् धनुर्वेदो रामो वा विप्रसत्तम। अथ साक्षाद्धरिहयः साक्षाद् वा विष्णुरच्युतः॥
en: Is the science of arms personified in you, or are you that best of Brahmanas (Parashu) Rama or Indra himself or Vishnu, or Achyuta himself?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तमेवं वादिनं तत्र फाल्गुनः प्रत्यभाषत। नास्मि कर्ण धनुर्वेदो नास्मि रामः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Hearing his these words, Falguni (Arjuna) replied, “ O Karna, I am not the science of arms; I am not also the powerful Rama.

sa: तां तु सेनां भृशं विद्ध्वा द्रावयित्वार्जुनः शरैः। प्रायादभिमुखः पार्थः सूतानीकं हि मारिष॥
en: Thus, with his arrows, dispersing the panicstricken army, O sire, Arjuna, the son of Pritha, advanced against the column commanded by the son of Suta.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच न व्याजेन चरेद् धर्ममिति मे भवतः श्रुतम्। न सत्याद् विचलिष्यामि सत्येनायुधमालभे॥
en: Arjuna said : I have heard from you that the virtue should not be practiced by quibbling. I shall not waver from truth. Truth is my weapon.

sa: रक्षसामीश्वरं मां च देवानां च भयंकरम्। हीनं मां मन्यसे केन अहीनं सर्वविक्रमैः॥
en: Why do you consider me, who am the lord of the Räksasa, and feared even by the immortals, as weak and reft of all power?

sa: प्रियं हितं च तद् वाक्यमुक्तवान् कुरुसत्तमः। भीष्मः शांतनवो राजन् प्रतिगृहणसि तन्न च॥ तथा द्रोणेन बहुधा भाषितं हितमुत्तमम्। तच्च राधासुतः कर्णो मन्यते न हितं तव॥
en: O king, the best of Kurus, the son of Shantanu (Bhishma) has said what is for your great good, but you do not accept it (his advice). What has been said by Drona is for your good, but the son of Radha, Karna, does not consider it for your good.

sa: द्विधा भज्येयमप्येवं न नमेयं तु कस्यचित्। एव मे सहजो दोषः स्वभावो दुरतिक्रमः॥
en: Better that I should be riven in twain, but bend I never will. This is my native fault; and nature is incapable of being overcome.

sa: तस्य राजन् गुरुकुले वसतो नित्यमेव च। समाप्ति नागमद् विद्या नापि वेदा विशाम्पते।॥
en: Although, O king, he lived long in the residence of his preceptor, he could not master any branch of learning or the Vedas, O monarch.

sa: वृत्र उवाच सत्येन तपसा चैव विदित्वासंशयं ह्यहम्। न शोचामि न हृष्यामि भूतानामागतिं गतिम्॥
en: Vritra said Forsooth, having understood, by the help of truth and penances, the coming and going of all living creatures, I have ceased to grieve or joy.

sa: तस्मात् सत्स्वपि वृद्धेषु कृष्णमर्चाम नेतरान्। एवं वक्तुं न चार्हस्त्वं मा ते भूद् बुद्धिरीदृशी॥
en: Therefore, we worship Krishna. Amongst the best and the oldest, we do not worship any other. you should not say so, your understanding should not be so.

sa: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः। इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्॥
en: Once more hcar My supernatural words, the most mysterious mystery of all. You are very dear to Me; therefore, I tell you what is good for you.

sa: अश्वांश्च चतुरः श्वेतान् निजघान शितैः शरैः। छित्त्वा ध्वजं रथं चैव शतधा पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: (And he) killed the white steeds with sharpened darts. (Then) that most exalted of the Bharatas, cutting the standard (of Karna) into a hundred pieces.

sa: गतायामथ तस्यां तु राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा। स्वप्नभूतमिदं सर्वमचिन्तयत भारत॥ विजेष्यामि रणे पाण्डूनिति चास्याभवन्मतिः।
en: O descendant of Bharata, when she disappeared, the king considered all this to be a dream. (He thought), “I shall defeat the Pandavas in battle."

sa: अपर्यन्ते बले मग्नो जह्यादपि च जीवितम्। तस्मिंश्च निहते युद्धे कथं जीवेत मादृशः॥
en: Sunk in his fathomless ocean of troops, Arjuna may be deprived of his life. And if he be slain in battle, how can I live?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इन्द्रतीर्थं ततो गत्वा यदूनां प्रवरो बलः। विप्रेभ्यो धनरत्नानि ददौ स्नात्वा यथाविधि॥
en: Vaishampayana said "The powerful chief of the Yadus, having gone to Indra's Tirtha, bathed there according to due rites and distributed wealth and gems amongst the Brahmanas.

sa: न मे स्वर्गो बहु मतः समानश्च सुरर्षभैः। त्वया राम विहीनस्य सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि ते॥
en: I am now in heaven and am equal with the celestials, but without you, O Rāma, I do not like it-this is true-I do swear by you.

sa: विक्रान्तस्य च वीरस्य युद्धे प्रार्थयतो यशः। शूर एव सहाय: स्यान्नेतरः प्रकृतो जनः॥
en: None but a hero volunteers to render help to another hero fighting courageously from a desire of winning fame. An ordinary man cannot do so.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतस्मिन् नेच्छति द्रष्टुं संग्रामं श्रोतुमिच्छति। वराणामीश्वरो व्यासः संजयाय वरं ददौ॥
en: Vaishampayana said On his not wishing to see the battle but to hear of it, that giver of boons Vyasa bestowed a boon on Sanjaya.

sa: सोऽहं भारं समाधास्ये त्वयि तं वोढुमर्हसि। अभिप्रायं च मे नित्यं न वृथा कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: I am now going to place a heavy burden on you; and it befits you to bear that burden; it behoves you not to disappoint my hopes.

sa: नारद उवाच नाभागमम्बरीषं च मृतं सृञ्जय शुश्रुम यः सहस्रं सहस्राणां राज्ञां चैकस्त्वयोधयत्॥
en: Narada said O Srinjaya, we heard that Nabhaga's son Ambarisha, who, single-handed, fought a thousand times against thousand kings, was also carried away by Death.

sa: संजय उवाच अर्जुनस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नोचुस्तत्र महारथाः। अप्रियं वा प्रियं वापि महाराज धनंजयम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Hearing the words of Arjuna O mighty monarch, the mighty car-warriors of the Pandava host spoke neither agreeable or disagreeable words in reply to Dhananjaya.

sa: शर्मिष्ठोवाच सोमस्येन्द्रस्य विष्णोर्वा यमस्य वरुणस्य च। तव वा नाहुष गृहे कः स्त्रियं द्रष्टुमर्हति॥ रूपाभिजनशीलैहि त्वं राजन् वेत्थ मां सदा। सा त्वां याचे प्रसाद्याहमृतुं देहि नराधिप॥
en: Sharmishtha said: O son of Nahusha, none can see the ladies that dwell in the inner-apartments of Soma, Indra, Vishnu, Yama, Varuna and your own. O king, you know that I am handsome and wellborn. O great king, I solicit you. My season has come. See that it goes not in vain.

sa: कालः सर्वं समादत्ते कालः सर्वं प्रयच्छति। कालेन विहितं सर्वं मा कृथाः शक्र पौरुषम्॥
en: It is Time that gives every thing and again takes away everything. It is Time that ordains all things. Do not, O Shakra, brag of your manliness.

sa: तमसा च महाराज रजसा च विशेषतः न किंचत् प्रत्यपश्याम शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम्॥
en: O great monarch, we could not behold anything in the field, either favourable or unfavourable, owing to the thick darkness and especially on account of the dust,

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यत्तद् वैकर्तनः कर्णो राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः। निशीथे समसजेतां तद् युद्धमभवत् कथम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How did that battle between Vikartarna's son Kama and the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha rage at that dead of night when they encountered each other?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः कुन्ती भीमसेनमर्जुनं यमजौ तथा। उवाच गमनं ते च तथेत्येवाब्रुवंस्तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon Kunti spoke to Bhimasena, Arjuna and the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) about the (proposed) journey and they said, “Be it so."

sa: स कुम्भकर्णस्य वचो निशम्य व्याविध्य शैलं सहसा मुमोच। तेनाजघानोरसि कुम्भकर्ण शैलेन वज्राशनिसंनिभेन।५९॥
en: Hearing Kumbhakarna's speech, Sugrīva whirling that mountain-peak, suddeniy let it go; and with that rock resembling Vajra or the thunder-bolt, smote Kumbhakarņa in the chest.

sa: स तेषु तर्पयामास भृगुन् भृगुकुलोद्वहः। साक्षाद् ददर्श चर्चीकं स च रामं न्यवारयत्॥
en: That perpetuator of the Bhrigu race then offered there oblations to his ancestors. Then Rechika appeared to him in a visible form and stopped him.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तस्ततः प्राह शाल्मलिः प्रहसन्निव। पवन त्वं च मे क्रुद्धो दर्शयात्मानमात्मना॥
en: Thus addressed, the Shalmali laughed in contempt and replied, saying,-O Wind-god, you are angry with me. Do not stop showing the extent of your power.

sa: तस्मै पर्णमयं दिव्यं दिव्यपुष्पाधिवासितम्। गन्धाढ्यं शयनं प्रादात् स शिश्ये तत्र वै सुखम्॥
en: The bird offered his guest a soft bed made of leaves and perfumed with many sweetscented flowers. Gautama lay on it, and felt great happiness.

sa: यथा संहरते जन्तून् ससर्ज च पुनः पुनः। अनादिनिधनो ब्रह्मा नित्यश्चाक्षर एव च॥
en: Listen to me how Brahman, who is eternal and undeteriorating, and who is without beginning and without end, repeatedly creates and destroys all created objects.

sa: भीष्म उवाच स तु स्वभावसम्पन्नस्तच्छ्रुत्वा मुनिभाषितम्। विनिवर्त्य मनः कामाद् धर्मे बुद्धिं चकार ह॥
en: Hearing these words of the sage, king Vasuman, having good disposition, withdrawing his mind from the pursuits of desire, set it upon the acquisition of virtue. a

sa: भळ य एष दत्तस्ते चर्मन्त्रपुरस्कृतः। एनं प्रयच्छ मह्यं त्वं मदीयं त्वं गृहाण च॥
en: Do you give me the charu, duly consecrated with hymns, which your husband has given you, and yourself take, the one that has been intended for me.

sa: दुःखमर्था हि युज्यन्ते पालनेन च ते सुखम्। दुःखेन चाधिगम्यन्ते नाशमेषां न चिन्तयेत्॥
en: Worldly belongings beget sorrow. In protecting them one can enjoy no happiness. They are again acquired with misery. One should not, therefore, mind their loss.

sa: मनुष्याणां तु मध्याह्ने प्रदद्यादुपपत्तिभिः। कालहीनं तु यद् दानं तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः॥
en: What is given to men should be given in the midday with love and regard. That gifts which is made untimely is taken by Rakshasas.

sa: कृत्स्नस्तु मन्त्रो विधिवत् प्रयुक्तो यथा यथोक्तास्त्विह दक्षिणाश्च। अन्नप्रदानं मनसः समाधिः पञ्चात्मकं कर्मफलं वदन्ति॥
en: Duly administered Mantras, sacrifices, the presents called Dakshina, gift of food and concentration of the mind are the five acts which yield fruits, there being none else.

sa: अत्र यत् प्रीतिसंयुक्तं काये मनसि वा भवेत्। वर्तते सात्त्विको भाव इत्यपेक्षेत तत् तथा॥
en: Whatever state of consciousness exists, regarding either the body or the mind, united with joy or satisfaction, should be considered as due to the quality of Goodness.

sa: यस्तु तिष्ठति कौन्तेय धारणासु यथाविधि। मरणं जन्मदुःखं च सुखं च स विमुञ्चति॥
en: That man, O son of Kunti, who practises Yoga-contemplation according to due rites succeeds in renouncing off both birth and death, and happiness and sorrow.

sa: सत्यं वेदेषु जागर्ति फलं सत्ये परं स्मृतम्। सत्याद् धर्मो दमश्चैव सर्वं सत्ये प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: Truth is awake in the Vedas. The fruits attached to truth have been described as the highest. From truth originate Righteousness and Self-control. Everything depends on truth.

sa: पुत्रास्ते कतमे राजन् जीवन्त्वेतत् प्रचक्ष्व मे। स्त्रीभूतस्य हि ये जाताः पुरुषस्याथ येऽभवन्॥
en: Joining her hands, the ascetic lady, answered Indra, saying O Vasava, let those sons of mine revive who were borne by me as a woman.

sa: इयं हि योनिः प्रथमा यां प्राप्य जगतीपते। आत्मा वै शक्यते त्रातुं कर्मभिः शुभलक्षणैः॥
en: Indeed, O king, that order of birth (viz., humanity) is the foremost, since by becoming a human being one succeeds in rescuing his self by meritorious acts.

sa: यदा भावं न कुरुते सर्वभूतेषु पापकम्। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा॥
en: When a person ceases to cherish a sinful attitude towards all creatures in thought, word, and deed, he is then said to attain to Brahima.

sa: जनक उवाच विशेषधर्मान् वर्णानां प्रबूहि भगवन् मम। ततः सामान्यधर्माश्च सर्वत्र कुशलो ह्यसि॥
en: Janaka said Tell me, O holy one, the especial duties of the several castes. Tell me also with their common duties are. You know everything.

sa: शक्र उवाच यस्मिन् वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च यस्मिन् देवा: प्रतिष्ठिताः। तृतीयं पादमग्निस्ते सुधृतं धारयिष्यति॥
en: Shakra said 'The Vedas, the sacrifices, and the gods are all established in Fire. Fire will bear your third quarter, when it is placed therein.'

sa: शक्र उवाच ये वै सन्तो मनुष्येषु ब्रह्मण्याः सत्यवादिनः। ते ते पादं तितिक्षन्तामलं सन्तस्तितिक्षितुम्॥
en: Shakra said They who are good among men devoted to Brahmanas, and truthful in speech, may bear your fourth quarter. The good have the power to it.

sa: ईश्वरो हि पुरा भूत्वा पितृपैतामहे पदे। तत्त्वमद्य हृतं दृष्ट्वा सपत्नैः किं न शोचसि॥
en: You were ere this a god, seated on the throne of your father and grandfathers. Finding yourself deprived to-day by your enemies, why do you not grieve?

sa: अथ सा स्त्री तथोवाच भगवन् पश्य वै रवेः। रूपं संध्याभ्रसंरक्तं किमुपस्थाष्यतां तव॥
en: The lady then addressed him, saying O illustrious one, look at the Sun reddened by the evening clouds! What service shall I do to you.

sa: चतुर्विधा हि लोकेऽस्मिन् यात्रा तात विधीयते। मा यत्रावतिष्ठन्ते सा च कामात् प्रवर्तते॥
en: Four modes of life, O child, have been laid down in this world. Wherever men live the means of maintenance come to them of themselves.

sa: इमं स्तवं संनियतेन्द्रियश्च भूत्वा शुचिर्यः पुरुषः पठेत। अभग्नयोगो नियतो मासमेकं सम्प्राप्नुयादश्ोधे फलं यत्॥
en: That person who, governing his senses and purifying himself, recites this hymn, continually for his vow, for one month, succeeds in acquiring the merit of a Horsesacrifices.

sa: किं श्रेयः सर्वभूतानामस्मिल्लोके परत्र चा यद् भवेत् प्रतिपत्तव्यं तद् भवान् प्रब्रवीतु मे॥
en: What is beneficial for all creatures both in this world and the next? Do you tell me what should be known by all about it.

sa: एतां बुद्ध्वा नरः सर्वां भूतानामागतिं गतिम्। अवेक्ष्य च शनैर्बुद्ध्या लभते शमनं ततः॥
en: He who has understood the three-fold objects and reflecting upon it, casts it away, succeeds by Yoga to see the Truth and secure perfect happiness.

sa: तत्रापि च मया दृष्टा दुह्यमाना पयस्विनी। लक्षितं च मया क्षीरं स्वादुतो ह्यमृतोपमम्॥
en: There I saw a cow that was being milked. And I saw the milk and it appeared to me to resemble nectar itself in taste.

sa: निरर्थको ह्ययं स्नेहो निष्फलश्च परिश्रमः॥ चक्षुर्त्यां न च कर्णाभ्यां सं शृणोति समीक्षते।
en: This your love has no meaning, and this caressing of the child is useless. He does not see with his eyes or hear with ears.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच प्रियः सर्वस्य लोकस्य सर्वसत्त्वाभिनन्दिता। गुणैः सर्वैरुपेतश्च को न्वस्ति भुवि मानवः॥
en: Yudhishthira said What man is there who is dear to all, who pleases all persons, and who is gifted with every merit and every accomplishment?

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततः प्रीतो भवो देव्याः प्रहसंश्चेदमब्रवीत्। गच्छत्वेष यथाकाममिति राजन् पुनः पुनः॥
en: Bhishma said Pacified by these words of his wife, Bhava smiled and said repeatedly these words, O king, viz.,-Let this one go wherever he likes.

sa: न याति च स तेजस्वी मध्येन नभसः कथम्। एतदिच्छामि विज्ञातुं निखिलेन पितामह॥
en: Though highly energetic, why can he not go to the centre of the sky? I wish, O grandfather, to learn everything about all these matters.

sa: शास्त्राल्लोकाच्च यो बुद्धः सर्वं पश्यति मानवः। असारमिव मानुष्यं सर्वथा मुक्त एव सः॥
en: That man who, enlightened by the scriptures and the experience of the world sees every human concern in this world to be unreal, becomes liberated.

sa: रूपं चक्षुस्तथा पाकस्त्रिविधं तेज उच्यते। रस: क्लेदश्च जिह्वा च त्रयो जलगुणाः स्मृताः॥
en: Form, cye, and digestion are the three-fold attributes of Fire or Energy. Taste all liquid secretions, and the tongue are the three attributes of Water.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवो दानेन तपसैव च। महात्मानो गताः स्वर्ग शिष्टात्मानो जितेन्द्रियाः॥
en: These and many others, endued with great and well-ordered souls, and having their senses under control, ascended, by means of gifts and penances, to heaven.

sa: त्यज धर्ममधर्म च तथा सत्यानृते त्यज। उभे सत्यानृते त्यक्त्वा येन त्यजसि तं त्यज।॥
en: Renounce both virtue and vice, and truth and falsehood. Having renounced truth and falsehood, do you cast off that by which these are to be shaken off.

sa: अकर्ता चैव कर्ता च कार्य कारणमेव च। यथेच्छति तथा राजन् क्रीडते पुरुषोऽव्ययः॥
en: He is both active and inactive. He is both Cause and Effect. He is the one immutable Soul, who sports as He likes, O king.

sa: सत्यं सत्यं हि नः शक्र वाक्यमेतत् सुनिश्चितम्। न यन्महेश्वरं मुक्त्वा कथाऽन्या मम रोचते॥
en: True it is, O Shakra, true are those words that I say to you. No other words are at all agreeable to me except those about Maheshvara.

sa: अस्तित्वं केवलत्वं च विनाभावं तथैव च। दैवतानि च मे ब्रूहि देहं यान्याश्रितानि वै॥ तथैवोत्क्रामिणः स्थानं देहिनो वै विपद्यतः। कालेन यद्धि प्राप्नोति स्थानं तत् प्रब्रवीहि मे॥
en: Do you describe to me then the existence and Oneness of Soul, of his separateness from Nature, of the gods which attach to the body, of the place to which embodied creatures go when they die, and that place to which they may ultimately, in course of time, be able to go.

sa: कपिल उवाच दर्श च पौर्णमासं च अग्निहोत्रं च धीमतः। चातुर्मास्यानि चैवासंस्तेषु धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Kapila said There are the Darsha, the Pauranmasha, the Agnihotra, the Chaturmashya, and other rites which an intelligent man should perform. Eternal merit consists in their performance.

sa: प्राणः स्पर्शश्च चेष्टा च वायोरेते गुणाः स्मृताः। इति सर्वगुणा राजन् व्याख्याताः पाञ्चभौतिकाः॥
en: Life, touch, and action are the properties of Wind. I have thus explained to you, O king, all the properties of the five principal elements.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो वायोः शाल्मलिीडितस्तदा। अतप्यत वचः स्मृत्वा नारदो यत् तदाब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing these words of the Wind, the Shalmali feit great shame. Remembering also the words of Narada, he began to repent greatly for his mistake.

sa: यत् तु संतापसंयुक्तं काये मनसि वा भवेत्। प्रवृत्तं रज इत्येवं तत्र चाप्युपलक्षयेत्॥
en: All such states of sorrow in either the body or the mind, should be considered as due to the influence of the quality of darkness.

sa: न त्रासिनो न चपला न रौद्राः सत्पथे स्थिताः। ते सेव्याः साधुभिर्नित्यं येष्वहिंसा प्रतिष्ठिता॥
en: They are perfectly fearless; they are tranquil; they are mild; and they always follow the right path. Full of mercy, they are always adored by the good.

sa: एषा गौः परलोकस्थं तारयिष्यति मामिति। यो दत्त्वा म्रियते जन्तुः सा गौः कं तारयिष्यति॥
en: The cow, it is said, will save me in the next world. The animal, however, which is given away, itself dies. Whom then will this cow save?

sa: महेश्वर उवाच दक्षो नाम महाभागे प्रजानां पतिरुत्तमः। हयमेधेन यजते तत्र यान्ति दिवौकसः॥
en: Maheshvara said 0 highly blessed lady, the excellent Prajapati Daksha is worshipping the gods in a House Sacrifice! These Dwellers of heaven are going there.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच य इमे पृथिवीपाला: शेरते पृथिवीतले। पृतनामध्य एते हि गतसंज्ञा महाबलाः॥
en: Yudhisthira said These kings who lie on the Earth's surface amid their respective armies, these princes of great power, are now all deprived of life.

sa: स्थाणुरुवाच संहारार्थं प्रसीदस्व मा क्रुधो विबुधेश्वर। मा प्रजाः स्थावरं चैव जङ्गमं च व्यनीनशत्॥
en: Do not give way to anger, O lord of the celestials, about the destruction of living creatures! Be-pleased! Let not these mobile and immobile beings be destroyed.

sa: कथं नाम भवेद् द्वेष्य आत्मा लोकस्य कस्यचित्॥ आत्मा हि पुरुषव्याघ्र ज्ञेयो विष्णुरिति स्थितिः।
en: O foremost of men, Vishnu is the soul of all beings. How, then can Vishnu be heated, for in hating him one would hate his own self.

sa: यमस्य भवने देव पात्यन्ते पापकर्मिणः। प्रसादये त्वां वरद प्रसादं कुरु मे प्रभो॥
en: All sinful creatures will have to sink into hell. I seek to please you, O boon-giving god! Extend to me your favour, O powerful lord.

sa: एकोऽस्य सुमहाप्राज्ञः दोषः स्यात् सुमहान् गुणः। क्षमया विपुला लोकाः सुलभा हि सहिष्णुता।॥
en: you of great wisdom, this attribute has only one defect. Its merits are many. By forgiveness, the man of self-control may easily acquire numberless worlds.

sa: उपमन्यु उवाच द्रक्ष्यसे पुण्डरीकाक्ष महादेवं न संशयः। अचिरेणैव कालेन यथा दृष्टो मयानघ॥
en: Upamanyu said Forsooth, O you having eyes like lotus petals, you will very soon see Mahadeva as, O sinless one, I succeeded in seeing him.

sa: स्त्रियं हत्वा मातरं च को हि जातु सुखी भवेत्। पितरं चाप्यवज्ञाय कः प्रतिष्ठामवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Who is there that can be happy after having killed a woman, especially his mother? Who again can acquire prosperity and fame by disobeying his own father.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच के पूर्वमासन् पतयः प्रजानां भरतर्षभ। के चर्षयो महाभागा दिक्षु प्रत्येकशः स्मृताः॥
en: Yudhishthira said Who are the first Patriarch, O foremost of Bharata's race? What highly blessed Rishis are there, and on which quarters do each of them dwell?

sa: न मांसं राघवो भुङ्क्ते न चैव मधु सेवते। वन्यं सुविहितं नित्यं भक्तमश्नाति पञ्चमम्॥
en: Rāghava dose not take meat nor drink honeyế he takes every day in the evening boiled rice and such wild fruits as are sanctioned by the Sastras.

sa: हयाश्च बहवो राजन् पत्तयश्च तथा पुनः। रथेभ्यो रथिन: पेतुस्तस्य नुन्नाः स्म सायकैः॥
en: As also numerous steeds and foot-soldiers, O king. Slain by the shafts of the Rakshasa, many car-warriors were dislodged from their seats in the car.

sa: का हि ते शक्तिरेकस्य बहूनां रणमूर्धनि । अस्माकमग्रतः स्थातुं किं पुनर्यो माहवे॥
en: What power hast you, being one to stay before us many in the field, what shall I say of your coping with us in conflict?

sa: न तु शस्त्रं ग्रहीष्यामि कथंचिदपि भाविनि। ऋते नियोगाद् विप्राणामेष मे समयः कृतः॥
en: But I shall not on any account take up arms except at the bidding of regenerate persons; for this is the vow I have made.

sa: ते दिशो विदिशः सर्वे प्रतिरुध्य प्रहारिणः। अभ्यघ्नन् विविधैः शस्त्रैस्ततो मे व्यथितं मनः॥
en: (And) all those dexterous in striking, obstructing all sides and directions, became engaged in the fight with various weapons, at which my mind was distressed.

sa: त्रैलोक्ये नास्ति यो द्वन्द्वं मम दद्यानराधिप। शङ्के प्रसक्तो भोगेषु न शृणोषि बलं मम॥
en: O king, there is none in this triune sphere that can combat with me. Having hitherto been sunk in lunacy, you have not heard of my strength.

sa: न शक्ष्यामि परित्यागं कर्तुं जीवन् कथंचन। यश्च कृत्स्नं रणे क्षत्रं विजेष्यति समागतम्॥
en: I shall never be able to abandon by any means so long I have some alive, even if a Kshatriyas comes to war with me.

sa: देवा हि मां हसिष्यन्ति दृष्ट्वा पूर्वापकारिणम्। कथमिन्द्रं जयिष्यामि कुम्भकर्ण हते त्वयि ॥
en: For the gods shall laugh on seeing me, who had formerly wronged them. But, how, O Kumbhakarņa, you having been slain, shall I conquer Indra?

sa: यद्यहं भ्रातृहन्तारं न हन्मि युधि राघवम्। ननु मे मरणं श्रेयो न चेदं व्यर्थजीवितुम्॥
en: If I do not slay in encounter that slayer of my brother-Rāghava, certainly death is even that which is good for me, otherwise, this life is useless.

sa: राज्येन नास्ति मे कार्य किं करिष्यामि सीतया। कुम्भकर्णविहीनस्य जीविते नास्ति मे मतिः॥
en: I have nothing to do with empire. And what shall I do with Sītā? And deprived of Kumbhakarma, I do not even wish to live.

sa: कृतः सेनापतिस्त्वेष त्वया भीष्मो नराधिप। सेनापतौ यशो गन्ता न तु योधान् कथंचन॥
en: By you, O ruler of men, has Bhishma been appointed the commander and all fame goes to the leader and never to an individual soldier.

sa: को जातु परभावां हि नारी व्यालीमव स्थिताम्। वासयेत गृहे जानन् स्त्रीणां दोषो महात्ययः॥
en: Who will permit a woman, who sighs for another and who is therefore like a poisonous snake, to remain in his house knowing the great evils thereof.

sa: उत्तङ्क उवाच तक्षकेण महीन्द्रेन्द्र येन ते हिंसित: पिता। तस्मै प्रतिकुरुष्व त्वं पन्नगाय दुरात्मने॥
en: Uttanka said : O king of kings, your father was killed by Takshaka, therefore take revenge on that vile serpent for the death of your noble father.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच पूर्वमेव यदा रामस्तस्मिन् युद्ध उपस्थिते। आमन्त्र्य केशवं यातो वृष्णिभिः सहितः प्रभुः॥
en: Janamejaya said On the eye the great battle (between the Kurus and the Pandus) Rama, with Keshava's permission, had left Dwaraka accompanied by many of the Vrishnis.

sa: यच्च त्वं मन्यसे प्राप्तं तद् ब्रवीहि सुयोधन। राधेय मन्यसे यच्च प्राप्तकालं वदाशु मे॥
en: O Duryodhana, as this is the (proper) time, tell me, therefore, what is in your mind and also, in the mind of the son of Radha (Karna.)

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भीममाह वचोऽर्थवत्। तूष्णीं भव न ते जल्प्यमिदं कार्यं कथंचन॥
en: Thereupon, king Yudhisthira spoke to Bhima these words of great import, “Keep your silence. Do not speak it out to any one in any way.

sa: अकृत्वा वचनं तात केशवस्य महात्मनः। श्रेयो न जातु न सुखं न कल्याणमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: By not acting up to the words of the great souled Keshava, will you not be able to obtain prosperity nor happiness nor your good.

sa: न च भार्यासमं किंचिद् विद्यते भिषजां मतम्। औषधं सर्वदुःखेषु सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: 'In all descriptions of misery there is no medicine similar to a wife, this is the opinion of all the physicians, I tell the forsooth.

sa: धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यस्य मे विषयं मुने। सम्प्राप्तो दर्शनं चैव नास्ति धन्यतरो मम ॥
en: Blessed are we, and obliged are we, whose domains, O ascetic, have been graced with your presence. Surely none is more blessed than I am.

sa: कृत्वा ह्यावसथान् वीरो यथाशास्त्रं यथाक्रमम्। सान्त्वयित्वा च राजेन्द्रो दत्त्वा च विविधं वसु।॥ विसर्जयामास नृपान् ब्राह्मणांश्च सहस्रशः। विसृज्य च नृपान् सर्वान् भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः॥ विवेश हास्तिनपुरं सहितः कर्णसौबलैः॥
en: Having built many pavilions that hero and the foremost of kings, duly entertained the monarchs and the Brahmanas by thousands.
