He bestowed upon them wealth of various kinds and then bade them farewell. having dismissed all the kings, surrounded by his brothers. He (Duryodhana) entered Hastinapur in company with Karna and Subala's son (Shakuni).

sa: न मां प्रीणाति राजेन्द्र लक्ष्मी: साधारणी विभो। ज्वलितामेव कौन्तेये श्रियं दृष्ट्वा च विव्यथे॥
en: O king of kings, O lord, this ordinary prosperity does not please me. I am greatly pained on seeing the burning prosperity of the son of Kunti.

sa: निवृत्तां तां सरिच्छेष्टां तत्र दृष्ट्वा तु लागली। बभूव विस्मितो राजन् बल: श्वेतानुलेपनः॥
en: Always smeared with white sandal-paste, Vala, having the plough for his weapon, seeing that great river change her course, was O king, filled with wonder.

sa: कृषामि मेदिनी पार्थ भूत्वा कार्णायसो महान्। कृष्णो वर्णश्च मे यस्मात् तस्मात् कृष्णोऽहमर्जुन॥
en: I till the Earth, taking the form of a large plough-share of black iron. And because my complexion is dark, therefore, am I called Vaikuntha.

sa: इत्युक्तवा स महायोगी पश्यति ध्यानचक्षुषा। स पश्यति महादेवं देवीं च वरदां शुभाम्॥ नारदं च महात्मानं तस्या देव्याः समीपतः। संतोषं परमं लेभे इति निश्चित्य योगवित्॥
en: Having said these words, that great Yogin saw the future with eyes of contemplation. He saw Mahadeva, and his divine consort, viz., that giver of excellent boons, with the great Narada sitting beside the goddess. Conversant with Yoga, Dadhichi became highly pleased, having ascertained what was about to take place.

sa: स एवमुक्तस्तां क्षत्रियां प्रत्युवाच भगवति सुनिवृता भव। न मां शक्तस्तक्षको नागराजो घर्षयितुमिति॥
en: Uttanka, being thus told, replied to the queen, "Madam, you need not be under any apprehension. Takshaka, the king of the Nagas, cannot overcome me."

sa: स शल्यमाभाष्य वाक्यं पार्थस्य कर्मातिशयं विचिन्त्य। मानेन दर्पण विदह्यमानः क्रोधेन दीप्यनिव निःश्वसंश्च॥
en: Thinking of the powerful feats of Arjuna, elated with self conceit and pride, worked up with anger and breathing hot and hard, said to Shalya-

sa: ये मदर्थे हता शूरास्तेषां कृतमनुस्मरन्। ऋणं तत् प्रतियुञ्जानो न राज्ये मन आदधे॥
en: Recollect with gratitude the deeds of those heroes that have died for me. I desire to satisfy my debt, instead of thinking of the kingdom.

sa: संजय उवाच दक्षिणेन तु नीलस्य मेरोः पार्श्वे तथोत्तरे। उत्तराः कुरवो राजन् पुण्याः सिद्धनिषेविताः॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, on the south of the Nila mountain and on the north of the Meru are the sacred Northern Kurus where dwell the Siddhas,

sa: जन्मप्रभृति कौन्तेया नित्यं विनिकृतास्त्वया। न च ते जातु कुप्यन्ति धर्मात्मानो हि पाण्डवा॥
en: Ever since their birth, have the sons of Kunti been persecuted by you but those virtuous-souled sons of Pandu are not vindictive at your conduct.

sa: तेऽपृच्छन्त पुरा सन्तः पूर्वजातं पितामहम्। यो नः श्रेष्ठस्तमाचक्ष्व स नः श्रेष्ठो भविष्यतिः॥
en: Those good beings formerly asked the first born Grandfather, saying, Do you say who amongst us is the foremost. He alone will be our chief.

sa: यस्त्वां वेत्ति स मां वेत्ति यस्त्वामनु स मामनु। नावयोरन्तरं किंचिन्मा तेऽभूद् बुद्धिरन्यथा॥
en: He who knows you knows me. He who follows you follows me! There is no difference between you and me. Do you never think otherwise.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच धनिनश्चाधना ये च वर्तयन्ते स्वतन्त्रणः। सुखदुःखागमस्तेषां कः कथं वा पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grandfather, whence and how happiness and misery approach the rich, and the poor, but who follow different practices and rites.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कथं समभवद् द्यूतं भ्रातृणां तन्महात्ययम्। यत्र तद् व्यसनं प्राप्तं पाण्डवैर्म पितामहैः॥
en: Janamejaya said How did that gambling take place, the play which was full of such evils to the brothers and which plunged my grandsires into such sorrow?

sa: न ह्येनामुत्सहे हन्तुं स्त्रीस्वभावेन रक्षिताम्। वीर्यं चास्या गतिं चैव हन्यामिति हि मे मतिः॥
en: But I dare not slay her, she being protected by virtue of her feminineness. I intend only to oppose her course, and deprive her of her prowess.

sa: धनुषा बाणमुत्सृज्य सघोषं विननाद च॥ ते न शर्म कुतः शान्ति लेभिरे स्म सुरास्तदा।
en: Shooting an arrow with his bow then, he uttered a tremendous roar. The celestials, who always perform acts beneficial to the world, the were filled with anxiety.

sa: गान्धार्या वचनं यत् तदृषीणां च परंतप॥ तन्नूनमन्यथा कर्तुं नैच्छत् स जगतः प्रभुः।
en: He was the Lord of the universe. He did not, however, wish to falsity the words of Gandhari and the Rishis, o destroyer of enemies.

sa: यस्याभावेन भूतानामभावः स्यात् समन्ततः। भावे च भावो नित्यं स्यात् कस्तं न प्रतिपूजयेत्॥
en: Who is there who will not worship him on whose existence depends the existence of the people and by whose destruction the people are destroyed?

sa: ततः पृषत्कान् प्रववर्ष राजा सूर्यो यथा रश्मिजालं समन्तात्। तैराशुगैर्वध्यमाना रथौधाः प्रदुद्रुवुः सहितास्तत्र तत्र॥
en: Meanwhile king Shalya began to discharge arrows like the Sun shedding his rays on all sides. Struck with those arrows, the (Pandava) car-warriors began to fly away.

sa: क्षिप्रं त्वं देवि शोकस्य पारं द्रक्ष्यसि मैथिलि। रावणं चैव रामेण द्रक्ष्यसे निहतं बलात्॥
en: O worshipful one, speedily shall you behold the other shore of your misery, O Maithili; and you shall see Rāvana slain by Rāma by might of arm.

sa: क्लेशान् कृतान् सपुत्रेण त्वया पूर्वं नराधिप। भय त्यक्त्वा रणे शूरा ब्रह्मलोकाय तत्पराः॥
en: Inflicted, O ruler of men, on them by you and your son and dismissing all fears, and desirous of attaining to the regions of Brahma,

sa: ततस्तु तं वै द्विरदं महात्मा प्रत्युद्ययौ त्वरमाणो जयाय। जम्भो यथा शक्रसमागमे वै नागेन्द्रमैरावणमिन्द्रवाह्यम्॥
en: The illustrious Dhrishtadyumna then quickly proceeded for defeating that elephant, as the Asura Jainbha had proceed against Airavata, the carrier of Indra, while he fought with Indra.

sa: ब्रह्मर्षीणां सतरं हि उवाह शिबिकां मम। स मामपनयो राजन् भ्रंशयामास वै श्रियः॥
en: Thousands of Brahmarshis were engaged in drawing my palanquin. And O king, this sin on my part brought about my fall from my exalted position.

sa: भावो योऽयमनुप्राप्तो भवितव्यमिदं मम। इति यस्य सदा भावो न स मुह्येत् कदाचन॥
en: That person never feels himself stupefied, who when placed in any particular condition, accepts it as that which he was ordained to be placed in.

sa: त्वरंस्ततो धर्मसुतो महात्मा शल्यस्य कोपान्नवभिः पृषत्कैः। भित्वा झुरस्तपनीयं च वर्म जघान षड्भिस्त्वपरैः पृषत्कैः॥
en: At this the illustrious son of Dharma, filled with rage, quickly struck Shalya's chest an then, without losing a moment, struck his golden mail with six arrows.

sa: प्रस्थाप्य तु स शत्रुघ्नं भ्रातृभ्यां सह राघवः। प्रमुमोद सुखी राज्यं धर्मेण परिपालयन्॥
en: Having bade adieu to Satrughna, Rama, the descendant of Raghu, was greatly delighted by governing his subjects piously in the company of Bharata and Laksmana.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अथोपगम्य कालस्तु तस्मिन् धर्मार्थसंशये। अब्रवीत् पन्नगं मृत्यु लुब्धं चार्जुनकं तथा॥
en: Bhishma said Then Kala arrived there where ethics were being discussed, and spoke thus to the serpent and Mrityu and the fowler Arjunaka assembled together.

sa: वेदे रामायणे पुण्ये भारते भरतर्षभ। आदौ चान्ते च मध्ये च हरिः सर्वत्र गीयते॥
en: In this Veda in the Ramayana and in the sacred Bharata, O chief of Bharata's race, Hari is sung ia the beginning, the middle, and the end.

sa: गते पतगराजे तु गालवः सह कन्यया। चिन्तयानः क्षमं दाने राज्ञां वै शुल्कतोऽगमत्॥
en: Went away, after for the permission of Galava, to his own place. And the king of birds having gone away Galava along with that maiden,

sa: य इदं पठते पर्व शृणुयाद् वापि नित्यशः। स मुच्यते महापापैः कृतैोरैश्च कर्मभिः॥
en: He, who reads or hears the recitation of this Parvan everyday is released from a great sins and the most wicked acts of his life.

sa: विप्रयुक्ता तु या पत्या मुहूर्तमपि जीवति। दुःखं जीवति सा पापा नरकस्येव पार्थिव॥
en: O king, she, who lives even for a moment after being separated from her husband that sinful woman, lives in great misery and in hell.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवः क्रुद्धो वालिनमब्रवीत्। तव चैष हरन् प्राणान् मुष्टिः पततु मूर्धनि ॥
en: Being accosted thus by Vāli, Sugrīva, exercised with wrath, spoke to him, saying,—This my fist shall strike you on your head taking away your life.

sa: कंचित् कालं तु वह्निं च स एव शमयिष्यति। समुद्रे वडवावको प्रक्षिप्य मुनिसत्तमः॥
en: For a little while he will put out the flames of that fiery rage, throwing it into the Mare's mouth that wanders through the ocean.

sa: य इदं पठते पर्व शृणुयाद् वापि नित्यशः। स मुच्यते महापापैः कृतैोरैश्च कर्मभिः॥
en: He, who reads or hears the recitation of this Parvan everyday is released from a great sins and the most wicked acts of his life.

sa: त्वं गत्वा बाहुदां शीघ्रं तर्पयस्व यथाविधि। देवानृषीन् पिढेश्चैवं मा चाधर्मे मनः कृथाः॥
en: Proceed forthwith to the river Vahuda and please duly, with oblations of water, the gods, Rishis, and the Pitris, and never again think of sin.

sa: अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसंधैः। भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथासौ सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः॥
en: All the son of Dhritarashtra, together with the host of kings, Bhishma Drona and Suta's son, Karna, with even the principle warriors of our side.

sa: एष सूते रणे पाषाणयोधिभिर्नूनं युयुधानः समागतः। तथा हि रथिनः सर्वे ह्रियन्ते विद्रुतैर्हयैः॥
en: Yonder the car-warriors are leaving Satyaki being borne away by their flying steeds. Behold some are falling down on the spot with their bodies mangled.

sa: कथं पश्येम हि वयं देवं नारायणात्मकम्। वरेण्यं वरदं तं वै देवदेवं सनातनम्॥ कथं पश्येम हि वयं देवं नारायणं त्विति। अथ व्रतस्यावभृथे वागुवाचाशरीरिणी॥ स्निग्धगम्भीरया वाचा प्रहर्षणकरी विभो।
en: The object we had in mind was how to see the divine Narayana in his own form. Upon the termination of our penances and after we had performed the final ablutions, we heard an incorporeal voice, O powerful Brihaspati, deep like that of the clouds and exceedingly melodious and filling the heart with joy.

sa: अग्नयो नैव दीप्यन्ते नैव दीप्यति भास्करः। ग्रहा नैव प्रकाशन्ते नक्षत्राणि न चन्द्रमाः॥
en: The fires that were lighted refused to blaze up. The Sun became dimmed. The Planets, the stars, and constellations, and the Moon, no longer shone.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच प्रत्यक्षकर्ता सर्वस्य नारदो भगवानृषिः। एष वक्ष्यति ते पृष्टो यथावृत्तं नरोत्तम॥
en: The illustrious Rishi Narada, who himself did so, is here, O best of men, asked by you, he will tell you everything that took place."

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यदिदं वेदवचनं दक्षिणासु विधीयते। इदं देयमिदं देयं न क्व चिद् व्यवतिष्ठते॥
en: Yudhishthira said There are Vedic texts relating to the gift of Dakshina in sacrifices. There is no ordinance, however, which says that so much should be given.

sa: दुःशासनं न पश्यामि नापि कर्णं महारथम्। नापि तान् सुहृदः सर्वान् किमिदं भरतर्षभ॥
en: I do not see Dussasana by you, nor the great car-warrior Karna, nor those hundreds of your friends. What is this, O foremost of men?

sa: देवस्थान उवाच यद् वचः फाल्गुनेनोक्तं न ज्यायोऽस्ति धनादिति। अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि तदेकान्तमनाः शृणु॥
en: Devasthana said *Phalguna has told you that there is nothing superior to wealth. I shall speak to you on that subject. Listen to me with rapt attention.

sa: तरसा ये न शक्यन्ते शस्त्रैः गुनिशितैरपि। साम्ना तेऽपि निगृह्यन्ते गजा इव करेणुभिः॥
en: Those, who cannot be subdued by force and Sharp weapons, can be conquered by insincere professions of love like (wild) elephants through a (tame) she-elephant.

sa: तं द्रोणपुत्रप्रमुखा नरेन्द्राः सर्वे समाश्वास्य मुहुः प्रयान्ति। निरीक्षमाणा मुहुरर्जुनस्य ध्वजं महान्तं यशसा ज्वलन्तम्॥
en: Consoling Duryodhana again and again all the kings headed by Drona's son returned to their camp looking repeatedly on Arjuna's standard that was resplendent with his glory.

sa: तं तथा युद्ध्यमानं च विनिघ्नन्तं च तावकान्। ईक्षितुं नोत्सहन्ते स्म तव सैन्या नराधिप॥
en: Your soldiers, at that time, O Bharata, dared not even took at that warrior who was fighting in that fashion and killing your men in that way.

sa: सुसूक्ष्मोऽपि तु देहे वै शल्यो जनयते रुजम्। किं पुनः शरसंघातैश्चित्तस्य तव पार्थिव॥
en: Even the smallest Pin when put into the body produces pain. What need then be said, O king, hundreds of arrows that have pierced you?

sa: शतं कन्या राजपुत्रमेकैकं पृथगन्वयुः। कन्यां कन्यां शतं नागा नागं नागं शतं रथाः॥
en: Each of those princes married a hundred princesses, and each princess brought a hundred elephants. With each each of those elephants were a hundred cars.

sa: बार्हस्पत्ये च शास्त्रे च श्लोको निगदितः पुरा। अस्मिन्नर्थे महाराज तन्मे निगदतः शृणु॥
en: In the Samhita of Brihaspati, a Sloka was recited in days of yore applicable to the present subject. Hear, O king, I shall recite it.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच यदर्थं राज्यमिच्छामि कुरूणां कुरुनन्दन। त इमे निहताः सर्वे भ्रातरो मे जनेश्वर॥
en: Duryodhana said The Kurus, O son of Kuru's race, for whose sake I desired sovereignty, those brothers of mine, O king, all lie dead on the field.

sa: तस्मान्नैव मृदुर्नित्यं तीक्ष्णो नैव भवेन्नृपः। वासन्तार्क इव श्रीमान् न शीतो न च धर्मदः॥
en: The king, therefore, should not always be mild. Nor should be always be terrific. He should be like the vernal sun, neither too cold nor too hot.

sa: सा तस्य हृदयं संख्ये बिभेद च तथा नृप॥ स पपात रथाद् भूमिं गतसत्त्वोऽल्पचेतनः।
en: That dart, O king, cut the heart of Satyasena in that battle into a hundred pieces and he fell down dead upon the Earth from his car.

sa: शीलस्य तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेत्तुं कौरवनन्दन। प्राप्यते च यथा शीलं तं चोपायं वदस्व मे॥
en: Duryodhana said O delighter of the Kurus, I wish to know the truth about conduct. Tell me the means by which it may be acquired.

sa: तस्मादेवं परं धर्मं मन्यन्ते धर्मकोविदाः। यो राजा रक्षणे युक्तो भूतेषु कुरुते दयाम्॥
en: Persons, conversant with duties, consider that to be the greatest merit of the king, when, engaged in protecting all creatures, he shows mercy towards them.

sa: न हि दैवेन सिध्यन्ति कार्याण्येकेन सत्तम। न चापि कर्मणैकेन द्वाभ्यां सिद्धस्तु योगतः॥
en: Success is not the out come of destiny alone nor of manliness alone, O best of men! Success results from the union of the two.

sa: उत्थायोत्थाय हि सदा प्रष्टव्या वृद्धसम्मताः॥ ते स्म योगे परं मूलं तन्मूला सिद्धिरुच्यते।
en: One engaged in a work should seek the advice of those approved by the aged. These men are the means, and success depends on means.

sa: सोऽहमेवं प्रणीतानि ज्ञात्वा शास्त्राणि तत्त्वतः॥ प्रविशेयं कथं पाशं त्वत्कृते तद् वदस्व मे।
en: I am well-read in the dictates of policy; tell me, why shall I enter to-day, for your sake, the net that is spread for me?

sa: शक्तितो हुनुपस्यामि निहतान् पाण्डवान् रणे। तेषां मध्ये स्थिता यत्र हन्यन्ते मम पुत्रकाः॥
en: While, my sons, stationed in the midst of those heroes and fighting vigorously in battle, have all been slain, what can it be but Destiny?

sa: वार्ष्णेयं प्रथमं राजन् प्रत्याख्याय महाबलम्॥ किमिदानीं ददासि त्वं को हि के चित्तविभ्रमः।
en: Having first refused the request of the great Krishna, who do you now desire to give away the Earth? What is this folly of yours?

sa: अद्य सौख्यं तु राजेन्द्र कुरुराजस्य दुर्मतेः॥ समाप्तं च महाराज नारीणां दर्शनं पुनः ।
en: To-day, O king, the happiness of this wicked king of the Kurus has terminated. After this day, O king, he shall not again see a beautiful damsel!

sa: यस्तु नापेक्षते कंचित् सहायं विजये स्थितः॥ विगाह्य वाहिनीमध्यं तस्य लोका यथा मम।
en: That warrior, who determined upon gaining victory, enters into the midst of the enemy's ranks without waiting for any help, acquires happy regions like mine.

sa: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् स्थाष्य कोपं जलाशये। स जलं पावको भूत्वा शोषयत्यनिशं प्रभो॥
en: Pleased, the great god threw his anger into the water. O king, assuming the from of fire, that wrath is always busy with consuming water.

sa: आवयोः कृतमन्योन्यं पुनः संधिर्न विद्यते। स्मृत्वा स्मृत्वा हि ते पुत्रं नवं वैरं भविष्यति।६८॥
en: There cannot be a reconciliation after what we have done to each other. Whenever you will thirt of your son, .'our enmity towards me will become fresh.

sa: तथोफ्यातं युधि धर्मराज दृष्ट्वा मुदा सर्वभूतान्यन्दन्॥ राहोर्विमुक्तं विमलं समग्रं चन्द्रं यथैवाभ्युदितं तथैव।
en: Like the brilliant full moon coming out of Rahu's grasp all the creatures were greatly delighted to see the virtuous king Yudhishthira in the battle-field.

sa: भवद्भिर्हिमवत्पृष्ठे यत् तपः समुपार्जितम्। अस्याश्च यत् तपो विप्रा न समं तन्मतं मम॥
en: The ascetic merit, you Rishis, that this lady has acquired, is, I think, much greater than what you have earned on the breast of Himavat!

sa: तदिदं व्याकुलं सर्वं कृतं धर्मस्य पीडनात्। भीमसेने न गोविन्द कामं तु यथाऽऽत्य माम्॥
en: It is because Bhimasena, has deviated from morality this harmony, of which I have spoken, has been disturbed, Inspite, O Govinda, of all your arguments to me!'

sa: एतान् घोराननादृत्य समुत्पातान् सुदारुणान्॥ पुनर्युद्धाय संयत्ताः क्षत्रियास्तस्थुरव्यथाः। रमणीये कुरुक्षेत्रे पुण्ये स्वर्ग यियासवः॥
en: Disregarding all those fierce and awful omens, the Kshatriyas, consulting with one another, cheerfully stood on the field of Kurukshetra, desirous of going to heaven.

sa: न च वैश्यस्य कामः स्यान्न रक्षेयं पशूनिति॥ वैश्ये चेच्छति नान्येन रक्षितव्याः कथंचन।
en: A Vaishya should never wish that he should not tend cattle. If a Vaishya desires to tend cattle no one else should undertake that task.

sa: भूमिप्रदानं कुर्याद् यः सुरां पीत्वा विमत्सरः। पुनर्नच पिबेद् राजन् संस्कृतः स च शुद्ध्यति॥
en: If a person, after having drunk wine, becomes humble and makes a gift of land, and abstains himself from it ever afterwards he becomes purified and cleansed.

sa: दीर्घसूत्रस्तु यस्तत्र सोऽब्रवीत् सम्यगुच्यते। न त कार्या त्वरा तावदिति मे निश्चिता मतिः॥
en: That one, amongst the three, who was idle then answered,-It is well said. There is, however, no necessity of such haste. This is my opinion.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तानभ्यर्च्य द्विजर्षभान्। सर्वान् विसर्जयामास ये तेनाभ्यागताः सह॥
en: Vaishampayana said "Hearing Narada, Rama bade a respectful farewell to those great Brahmanas and sent away all those that had accompanied him (in। his pilgrimage).

sa: यन्न तस्य मनो ह्यासीत् त्वयोक्तस्य हितं वचः। प्रशमे पाण्डवैः सार्ध सोऽन्यस्य शृणुयात् कथम्॥३४
en: How could he listen to the advice of another when, indeed, he could not make up his mind to make peace with the Pandavas following your advice.

sa: येन शान्तनवो वीरो द्रोणो विदुर एव च। प्रत्याख्याताः शमस्यार्थे किं नु तस्याद्य भेषजम्॥
en: What medicine can be agreeable to that man today who discovered Bhishma, the son of Shantanu and Drona and Vidura, while they urged him to make peace.

sa: तं तथा युद्ध्यमानं च विनिघ्नन्तं च तावकान्। ईक्षितुं नोत्सहन्ते स्म तव सैन्या नराधिप॥
en: Your soldiers, at that time, O Bharata, dared not even took at that warrior who was fighting in that fashion and killing your men in that way.

sa: स्वस्ति प्राप्नुत भद्रं वः स्वर्गे न: संगमः पुनः। इत्येवमुक्त्वा तूष्णीं च कुरुराजो महामनाः॥
en: Good be to you all. May you prosper. All of US will again meet together in heaven.'-Having said this the great king of the Kurus became silent.

sa: उत्सृज्य तु शुभा देहं जगामास्य च भार्यताम्॥ तपसोग्रेण तं लब्ध्वा तेन रेमे सहाच्युत।
en: The auspicious Shrutavati then renouncing her body, became the wife of Indra. Obtaining that dignity through austere penances, she began to pass her time, sporting with him."

sa: तत्र गुल्मा: परित्रस्ताः सूर्ये चास्तमिते सति॥ सर्वे विचुक्रुशुः श्रुत्वा पुत्राणां तव संक्षयम्।
en: The sun had set a little before. Learning that all your sons had been killed the troops, forming the outposts of the camp, wept aloud.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः कर्णे हते राजन् धार्तराष्ट्रः सुयोधनः। भृशं शोकार्णवमग्नो निराशः सर्वतोऽभवत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said After the destruction of Karna, O king, Dhritarashtra's son Suyodhana was immersed in a sea of grief and beheld despair on all sides.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीद् रौहिणेयो नारदं दीनया गिरा॥ किमवस्थं तु तत् क्षत्रं ये तु तत्राभवन् नृपाः।
en: The Rohini's son then, in sorrowful words, enquired of the Rishi, saying-'What is the state of the field? How are those kings now that had assembled there?

sa: स विसृज्याश्रु नेत्राभ्यां बहुमानात् कृताञ्जलिः। उवाच कौशिकं रात्रौ ब्रह्मन् किं ते चिकीर्षितम्॥
en: Clasping his hands from respect and with eyes bathed in tears, he addressed Kushika's son, saying,-What do you seek here in the night, O Brahmana?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं स्विदिह राजेन्द्र पालयन् पार्थिवः प्रजाः। प्रीतिं धर्मविशेषेण कीर्तिमानोति शाश्वतीम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O foremost of kings, what is that method by which a king governing his subjects may, thereby, acquire great blessedness and eternal fame?

sa: संजय उवाच ततस्ते प्रययुः सर्वे निवासाय महीक्षितः। शङ्खान् प्रध्मापयन्तो वै हृष्टाः परिघबाहवः॥
en: Sanjaya said "All those kings, having arms resembling spiked bludgeons, then went towards their tents, overflowing with joy and blowing their conchs on their way.

sa: भूयांसं लभते क्लेशं या गौर्भवति दुर्दुहा। अथ या सुदुहा राजन् नैव तां वितुदन्त्यपि॥
en: That cow which cannot be easily milked suffer much pain. On the other hand, that cow which is easily milked, has not to suffer any pain whatever.

sa: लम्वा तु स नृपः संज्ञा वेपमानः सुदुःखितः॥ उदीक्ष्य च दिशः सर्वाः क्षत्तारं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। विद्वन् क्षत्तर्महाप्राज्ञ त्वं गतिर्भरतर्षभ॥ ममानाथस्य सुभृशं पुत्रैर्हीनस्य सर्वशः। एवमुक्त्वा ततो भूयो विसंज्ञो निपपात ह॥ तं तथा पतितं दृष्ट्वा बान्धवा येऽस्य केचन। शीतैस्ते सिषिचुस्तोयैर्विव्यजुर्व्यजनैरपि॥ स तु दीर्घेण कालेन प्रत्याश्वस्तो नराधिपः। तूष्णीं दध्यौ महीपाल: पुत्रव्यसनकर्शितः॥ निःश्वसञ्जिह्मग इव कुम्भक्षिप्तो विशाम्पते।
en: Having recovered his consciousness, the king, with trembling limbs and aggrieved heart, looked of all sides and said these words to Kshatta Vidura:-"O learned Kshatta, O you of great wisdom, O foremost of Bharata's race, you are now my refuge! I am lordless and all my sons are dead"-Having said so, he once more dropped down unconscious. Beholding him fallen, all his relatives, that were present there, sprinkled cold water over him and fanned him. Comforted after a long while, that king stricken with sorrow on account of the death of his sons, remained silent, sighing heavily, like a snake put into a pot.

sa: यथा काष्ठं च काष्ठं च समेयातां महोदधौ। समेत्य च व्यपेयातां तद्वद् भूतसमागमः॥
en: As two pieces wood, floating on the great ocean, come together and are again separated, so creatures are united and are again separated in time.

sa: किं नु शोचति भर्तारं पुत्रं चैषा मनस्विनी। तथा ह्यवस्थिता भाति पुत्रं चाप्यभिवीक्ष्य सा॥
en: At one time she is grieving for her husband, and again for her son. At one time she looks on her lord, and again on her son.

sa: स त्वमातिष्ठ कार्याणि मा तेऽभूद् ग्लानिरच्युत। शत्रून् जहि प्रजा रक्ष द्विजांश्च परिपूजय॥
en: Do you attend to your duties now, O you of unfading glory, do not grieve, Kill your enemies, protect your subjects, and worship the Brahmanas.

sa: तेन वज्रेण भगवान् मन्त्रयुक्तेन भारत। भृशं क्रोधविसृष्टेन ब्रह्मतेजोद्भवेन च॥ दैत्यदानववीराणां जघान नवतीनव।
en: With the thunder-bolt created by Brahma and inspired with mantras, O Bharata, Indra made a loud noise when he hurled it and killed ninety-nine Daityas.

sa: एह्येहि पुत्र राजेन्द्र ममानाथस्य साम्प्रतम्। त्वया हीनो महाबाहो का नु यास्याम्यहं गतिम्॥
en: Come, come, O king of kings, to me that am without a lord now! Deprived of you, O mighty-armed one, what will be my condition?

sa: तस्माद् बुद्ध्यन्ति पुरुषा न हि तत् कस्यचिद्धवम्। श्रद्धानस्ततो लोको दद्याच्चैव यजेत च॥
en: Therefore the wise think that wealth, forsooth, is nobody's on Earth. One should celebrate Sacrifices with it and give it away with a confident heart.

sa: सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं भूतानां पर्युपस्थितम्। प्राप्तव्यमवशैः सर्वं परिहारो न विद्यते॥
en: Happiness or sorrow whatever comes upon creatures, it should be enjoyed or borne without elation or depression. There is no means of escaping from them.

sa: मा ते राष्ट्रे याचनका भूवनमा चापि दस्यवः। एषां दातार एवैते नैते भूतस्य भावकाः॥
en: Let there be no beggars or robbers in your kingdom. It is only the robbers who give to the beggars. Such givers are not benefactors of men.

sa: केचिन्न सम्यक् पश्यन्ति मूढाः सम्यगवेक्ष्य च। तदिदं मम मूढस्य तथाभूतं वचः स्म तत्॥
en: There are some fools that do not see things even though they cașt their eyes on them. Those words of Vidura have proved true in my case.

sa: कथं त्वां सर्वधर्मज्ञं क्षुद्रः पापो वृकोदरः। निकृत्या हतवान् मन्दो नूनं कालो दुरत्ययः॥
en: Alas, how could the wretched and mean Vrikodara unfairly strike you down, righteous as you always were in all your action. Forsooth! Time is irresistible.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप। धर्मवृत्तं च वित्तं च वृत्त्युपायाः फलानि च॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have, O scorcher of foes, described the duties, the general conduct, the means of sustenance, with their results, of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras.

sa: सहस्व श्रियमन्येषां यद्यपि त्वयि नास्ति सा। अन्यत्रापि सती लक्ष्मी कुशला भुञ्जते सदा॥
en: Bear the prosperity of others, inspite of your being divested of the same. Clever and expert men succeed in enjoying the prosperity of their enemies.

sa: पितामहाशा महती ममासीद्धि सुयोधने। प्राप्ते युद्धे तु तद् युक्तं तत् कर्तायमिति प्रभो॥
en: O grandfather, I had great hope about Suyodhana that when a battle was about to take place, he would, O lord, do what was proper.

sa: ते चैव भ्रातरः पञ्च वासुदेवोऽथ सात्यकिः। अहं च कृतवर्मा च कृपः शारद्वतस्तथा॥
en: Then seven on their side and are the five brothers and Vasudeva and Satyaki; on our side, we three are myself and Kripa and Kritavarman.

sa: कृत्वा समयमव्यग्रो भवान् वै सहितो मया॥ यो भवेद्धदि संकल्पः शुभो वा यदि वाशुभः। अन्योन्यस्य स आख्येय इति तद् वै मृषा कृतम्॥ भवता वचनं ब्रह्मस्तस्मादेष शपाम्यहम्।
en: And he said, ‘Having of your own accord made an agreement with me that, whatever wish, good or bad, would be entertained by either of us should be disclosed to the other you have violated it! These were your own words. O Brahman! It is for this that I shall curse you.

sa: युद्धधर्मेषु सर्वेषु क्रियाणां नैपुणेषु च। न त्वया सदृशः कश्चित् त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते॥
en: There is no one equal to you in the three worlds in all duties connected with battle and in skill in various kinds of acts,

sa: प्रीतिप्रवृत्तौ विनिवर्तितौ यथा सुहृत्सु विज्ञाय निवृत्य चोभयोः। यदेव मित्रं गुरुभारमावहेत् तदेव सुस्निग्धमुदाहरेद् बुधः॥
en: When two friends engage in doing one and the same act, a wise man always praises him among the two who undertakes the heavier share of work.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अहोऽभिहितमाख्यानं भवता तत्त्वदर्शिना। भूय एव तु मे हर्षः श्रुत्वा वागमृतं तव॥
en: Dhritarashtra said “Excellent is this parable which you have described. Indeed, you are acquainted with Truth. Having listened to your nectar-like speech, I desire to hear more.'

sa: न चापि शक्तः संयन्तुं कोपमेतं समुत्थितम्। तं न पश्यामि लोकेऽस्मिन् यो मां कोपान्निवर्तयेत्।।
en: I am unable to check this rising anger in my heart. I do not see the man in this world than can suppress this wrath of mine.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यथा वृत्त्या महीपालो विवर्धयति मानवान्। पुण्यांश्च लोकान् जयति तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Describe to me, O grandfather, the conduct by which a king succeeds in advancing his subjects and earning regions of happiness in the other world.

sa: किं नु दुःखतरं कृष्णं परं मम भविष्यति। यत् सुता विधवा बाला स्नुषाश्च निहतेश्वराः॥
en: What, O Krishna, can be a greater grief to me than that my young daughter should be a widow and all my daughters-in-law should equally be so.

sa: यमाश्रित्याकरोद् वैरं पुत्रस्ते स गतो दिवम्। आदाय तव पुत्राणां जयाशां शर्म वर्म च॥
en: Thus repaired to the celestial region the hero depending upon whom your son made enemies taking with him the hope of success and joy of the Kauravas.

sa: दुःखं नूनं कृतान्तस्य गतिं ज्ञातुं कथंचन। लोकानां च भवान् यत्र शेषे पांसुषु रूषितः॥
en: Forsooth, it is difficult to learn the ways of Yama, since you, O lord of all the world, thus lie on the bare ground covered with dust.

sa: गान्धार्याश्च यथा पुत्रास्तथा कुन्तीसुता मम। यथा च मम ते रक्ष्या धृतराष्ट्र तथा तव॥
en: The sons of Gandhari are (as dear) to me as the sons of Kunti. O Dhritarashtra, they are to be protected as much by me as you.

sa: यदि मे हृदयं वेत्सि यदि ते प्रत्ययो मयि। भीमसेनार्जुनौ शीघ्रं न्यासभूतौ प्रयच्छ मे॥
en: If you know my heart, if you have any faith in me, then without any further loss of time, give me as a pledge Bhima and Arjuna.

sa: राजसूयाश्वमेधाद्यैः सोऽयजद् बहुभिः सवैः। सुहोत्रः पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां बुभुजे सागराम्बराम्॥ पूर्णां हस्तिगजाश्चैश्च बहुरत्नसमाकुलाम्। मम व मही तस्य भूरिभारावपीडिता॥ हस्त्यश्वरथसम्पूर्णा मनुष्यकलिला भृशम्। सुहोने राजनि तदा धर्मतः शासति प्रजाः॥
en: He performed many Rajasuya and Horsesacrifices. He subjugated the whole earth bounded by the four seas, And full of elephants, kine, horses and great wealth of gems and gold. The earth was, as it were, sinking with the weight of numberless human beings, elephants, horses and cars. Suhotra virtuously ruled over all his subjects.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच युधिष्ठिर न संतापस्त्वया कार्यो वृकोदरे। न चायं बुद्धिदौर्बल्याद् व्यवसायः कृतो मया॥
en: Kunti said: ( Yudhisthira, you need not be anxious for Vrikodara. I have not resolved (to do it) out of any weakness of my understanding.

sa: अक्षौहिणी वा सैन्यस्य कस्य किं वा ददाम्यहम्। वत्रे दुर्योधनः सैन्यं मन्दात्मा यत्र दुर्मतिः॥
en: And one Akshauhini of my soldiers, between these two which shall I give to you?" Blind to his own interest, the foolish' Duryodhana asked for the soldiers.

sa: एतत् सर्वं समीक्ष्य त्वमात्मत्यागं च गर्हितम्। आत्मानं तारयाद्याशु कुलं चेमौ च दारकौ॥
en: Having considered all this and knowing that your self-sacrifice is censurable, save today yourself, your race and your these two children without loss of time.

sa: वासुदेवस्य माहात्म्यं पाण्डवानां च सत्यताम्।। दुर्वृत्तं धार्तराष्ट्राणामुक्तवान्भगवानृषिः। इदं शतसहस्रं तु लोकानां पुण्यकर्मणाम्॥
en: He has also described the divinity of Vasudeva (Krishna), the goodness of the sons of Pandu and the evil conduct of the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sa: आकाङ्क्षन्ते च दौहित्रान् मयि नित्यं पितामहाः। तत् स्वयं वै परित्रास्ये रक्षन्ती जीवितं पितुः॥
en: My forefathers always desire to have daughter's son by me, (to save them from hell). I shall myself save them by saving the life of my father.

sa: मन्यसे यं त तातेति नैष तातस्तवानघ। आर्य एष पिता तस्य पितुस्तव यशस्विनः॥
en: O sinless one, he is not your father whom you consider to be (your father). The reverend man is the father of your illustrious father.”

sa: एवं सर्वान् वशे चक्रे जरासंधः शतावरान्। तं दुर्बलतरो राजा कथं पार्थ उपैष्यति॥
en: O son of Pritha, thus has be brought under his sway one hundred kings. How can then a weak king approach him with hostile intentions?

sa: जातमात्रं पुरा दृष्ट्वा तं पुत्रं शान्तनुस्तदा। नोपलेभे स्मृति धीमानभिज्ञातुं तमात्मजम्॥ तदद्भुतं ततो
en: Shantanu had seen him only once, a few minutes after his birth; therefore, he had not sufficient recollection to identify that youth with his son.

sa: तस्मिन् वने महाघोरे खगांश्च बहुशोऽहनत्। हत्वा च सुचिरं श्रान्तो राजा निववृते ततः॥
en: He also killed in that greatly fearful forest many rhinoceroses. Thus killing (animals) for a long period, the king became tried and refrained from it.

sa: विमृद्य तरसा राष्ट्र पुरं ते मृदितं मया। प्राप्य जीवं रिपुवशं सखिपूर्वं किमिष्यते॥
en: "Your kingdom and your capital have been laid waste by me. Receiving your like at my hand, do you desire to revive our old friendship?".

sa: स मार्यमाणो भीमेन ननाद विपुलं स्वनम्। पूरयंस्तद् वनं सर्वं जलाई इव दुन्दुभिः॥
en: When he was thus killed by Bhima, he sent forth a terrible roar like the sound of a wet drum which filled the whole forest.

sa: समयो ह्येष मे पूर्वं त्वया सह मिथ: सुखमभ्युषितो भद्रे ब्रूयास्त्वं भ्रातरं शुभे॥
en: This was my agreement made with you and your brother, O amiable lady, I have passed happily with you. O fair lady, tell your brother,

sa: देहस्यान्यस्य सद्भावे प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि । तमुवाच ततो ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूरमितप्रभः॥ मित्रावरुणज तेज आविश त्वं महायशः। अयोनिजस्त्वं भविता तत्रापि द्विजसत्तम्। धर्मेण महता युक्तः पुनरेष्यसि मे वशम्॥
en: Whereto the self-sprung Brahma, of unmitigated prowess, replied. O great one, do you enter into the vital energy of Mitra and Varuņa; and even then, O foremost of twiceborn ones, you shall not be born of a woman and being greatly pious shall attain to the rank of a patriarch.

sa: मुरं च नरकं चैव शास्ति यो यवनाधिपः। अपर्यन्तबलो राजा प्रतीच्यां वरुणो यथा।॥
en: That king of the Yavanas who is chastised Mura and Naraka and who is the matchlessly powerful king of the west like a (second) Varuna.

sa: तक्षक उवाच किमर्थं तं मया दष्टं संजीवयितुमिच्छसि। अहं स तक्षको ब्रह्मन्पश्य मे वीर्यमद्भुतम्॥ न शक्तस्त्वं मया दष्टं तं संजीवयितुं नृपम्। इत्युक्त्वा तक्षकस्तत्र सोऽदशद्वै वनस्पतिम्॥
en: Takshaka said: O Brahmana, I am that very Takshaka. Why do you wish to revive the king bitten by me? Behold my wonderful power. You are incapable of reviving the king bitten by me." Having said this, Takshaka there and then bit a lord of the forest (a banian tree).

sa: एकलव्य उवाच किं प्रयच्छामि भगवन्नाज्ञापयतु मां गुरुः॥ न हि किंचिददेयं मे गुरवे ब्रह्मवित्तम।
en: O illustrious one, what shall I give you, command me. O excellent Brahma knowing man, there is nothing that is not to be given to my preceptor."

sa: इति सर्वमशेषतो मया कथितं संभवकारणं तु सौम्य नृपपुङ्गव शाफ्जं द्विजस्य द्विजशापाच्च यदद्भुतं नृपस्य।
en: O gentle one, I have thus related to you the wondrous births, in consequence of the curse, of the great ascetic Vasistha and the royal saint Nimi.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच उपपन्नं सतामेतद् यद् ब्रवीषि तपोधने। न तु दुःखमिदं शक्यं पानुषेण व्यपोहितम्॥
en: The Brahmana said : O ascetic lady, what you say is no doubt worthy of virtuous men. But this grief cannot be removed by any human being.

sa: अयं तु यत्कृते यूयं मया शप्ताः स वत्स्यति। द्यौस्तदा मानुषे लोके दीर्घकालं स्वकर्मणा॥
en: But he for whose act you have all been cursed by me, that Dyo, will have to remain on earth for long for his own (sinful) act.

sa: क्षत्तर्यद् गुरुराचार्यो ब्रवीति कुरु तत् तथा। न हीदृशं प्रियं मन्ये भविता धर्मवत्सल॥
en: O Kshatta (Vidura), do all that the respected preceptor says. O lover of virtue, I think nothing can be more agreeable to me than this.

sa: शृणु राजन् मम वचो यत् त्वा वक्ष्यामि सुव्रत। आदित्यवंशप्रभवस्त्वं हि लोके परिश्रुतः॥
en: “O king of excellent vows, listen to what I say; it is known all over the world that you are born in the solar dynasty.

sa: अद्य पाण्डुम॒तो राजा मम भ्राता महायशाः। तेषु वीरेषु दग्धेषु मात्रा सह विशेषतः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said: King Pandu, my illustrious brother, has (indeed) died to day, when those heroes (the Pandavas) with their mother have been burnt to death.

sa: रूपेण वयसा चैव कन्दर्पण च दर्पिताः। अयुक्तं कृतवत्यः स्म क्षन्तुमर्हसि नो द्विज॥
en: (We said), "O Brahmana, intoxicated with beauty and youth and maddened by the god of love, we have acted very improperly, you should pardon us.

sa: कण्व उवाच प्रसन्न एव तस्याहं त्वत्कृते वरवर्णिनी। गृहाण च वरं मत्तस्त्वं शुभे यदभीप्सितम्॥
en: Kanva said: O beautiful child, I am prepared to bless him for your sake. But O blessed girl, receive from me the boon you desire to have.

sa: अयं शापादृषेस्तस्य एक एव नृपोत्तम। द्यौ राजन् मानुषे लोके चिरं वत्स्यति भारत॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, O excellent king, the only one, namely Dyo himself, is to live earth on account of the Rishi's curse.

sa: सोऽयं पितृवधान व्यक्तं क्रोधाद् वो हन्तुमिच्छति। तेजसा तस्य दिव्येन चढूंषि मुषितानि वः॥
en: Being enraged at the slaughter of his fathers; he desires to kill you, it is by his celestials effulgence that your eye-sight has been destroyed.

sa: यथाशं कुरु सौमित्रे त्यज्य मां दुःखभागिनीम्। निदेशे स्थीयतां राज्ञः शृणु चेदं वचो मम॥
en: O Saumitri, do you carry out the orders you have received. By renouncing this wretched wight do you satisfy the King's orders. But hear, what I say.

sa: तत्र यास्यत्ययं वर्चा न च स्थास्यति वै चिरम्। ऐन्द्रिनरस्तु भविता यस्य नारायणः सखा॥
en: Let this Varcha go, but let him not stay long on earth. Nara will be born as Indra's son and he will have Narayana as his friend.

sa: अनेनैव च विख्यातो नाम्ना लोकेषु सत्तमः। स और्व इति विप्रर्षिरूकै भित्त्वा व्यजायत॥
en: As he was born after tearing open his mother's thigh, that excellent Brahmana came to be know throughout the world by the name of Aurva.

sa: सोमश्च शक्रो वरुणः कुबेरः साध्या रुद्रा वसवोऽथाश्चिनौ च। प्रजापतिर्भुवनस्य प्रणेता समाजग्मुस्तत्र देवास्तथान्ये॥
en: Soma, Shakra, Varuna, Kubera, the Sadhyas, the Rudra, the Vasus, the twin Ashvinis, these and other celestials went to Prajapati, the creator of the world.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः स द्रुपदो राजा हर्षव्याकुललोचनः। प्रतिवक्तुं मुदा युक्तो नाशकत् तं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon the king Drupada had his eyes rolling in ecstasy and he was filled with delight; he could not for some time answer Yudhishthira.

sa: समयेन प्रदद्यां ते कन्यामहमिमां नृप। न हि मे त्वत्समः कश्चिद् वरो जातु भविष्यति।॥
en: O king, if you give me the pledge, I shall then bestow my daughter on you, for I can never obtain a husband for her like you."

sa: लोकपालो न तां वाचमुक्त्वा मिथ्या करिष्यति। समक्षं बन्धुकृत्ये न तेन तं स्वस्थ मानसम्॥
en: Being the protector of creatures, he (Agni) will never falsify his words. You have no anxiety in your mind, your heart is never inclined towards your friends.

sa: त्यजेयं विप्रिये च त्वां कृते वासं च ते गृहे। एतद्गृहाण वचनं मया यत्समुदीरितम्॥
en: I shall then leave you and no longer live in the house, if you do any such thing. Bear in mind these words that I have spoken.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इति स दुपदो राजा स्वयंवरमगोषयत्। तच्छ्रुत्वा पार्थिवाः सर्वे समीयुस्तत्र भारत॥
en: came Vaishampayana said : With these words, the king Drupada proclaimed the Svaimvara. O descendant of Bharata, having heard this, all the kings came there.

sa: पाङ्गुण्यस्य पदं वेत्ति नीतिकर्ता स राघवः। सर्वज्ञः सर्वदर्शी च रामो रमयतां वरः॥
en: He is perfectly cognisant of where the six qualities are to be applied master of morality, know all, see all and the best of beautiful.

sa: प्रणीतं सज्जनमनो वैक्लव्याश्रुप्रवर्तकम्। सप्तविंशतिरध्यायाः पर्वण्यस्मिप्रकीर्तिताः॥ श्लोकसप्तशती चापि पञ्चसप्ततिसंयुता। संख्यया भारताख्यानमुक्तं व्यासेन धीमता॥
en: Its perusal moves every heart and draws tears from every eye. It contains twenty-seven chapters and its number of slokas is seven hundred and seventy-five.

sa: तेषां विचरतां तत्र तत्तत्कर्मचिकीर्षया। श्वा चरन् स वने मूढो नैषादि प्रति जग्मिवान्॥
en: They wondered about the forest, intent on the purpose they had in view; the dog also wandered about alone and came to the Nishada (prince).

sa: तस्य ते युद्धकामस्य युद्धं दास्यामि दुर्मते। तिष्ठ त्वं च मुहूर्त तु यावदायुधमानये॥
en: O you of vicious intellect, if you wish I shall fight with you. Do you wait here so long I do not bring my weapon.

sa: न चापि तव संकल्प मोघमिच्छामि दानव। कृष्णस्य क्रियतां किंचित् तथा प्रतिकृतं मयि॥
en: O Danava, I am not willing to frustrate your intention also. Do something for Krishna; that will be sufficient requital for my services to you.

sa: भुजंगं वै सदा हन्यां यं यं पश्येयमित्युत। ततोऽहं त्वां जिघांसामि जीवितेनाद्य मोक्ष्यसे॥
en: Namely that I would kill every snake that I might meet with. Therefore I shall strike you and you shall be deprived of your life.

sa: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच त्रयाणां केन ते राजन् योद्धमुत्सहते मनः। अस्मदन्यतमेनेह सज्जीभवतु को युधि॥
en: Krishna said O king, with whom amongst us three you have the mind to fight? Who amongst us should be ready for battle (with you)?

sa: स्ते गंगता गुणवन्तस्तु सर्वे। शक्राच लब्धो हि वरो मयैष पतिष्यता भूमितलं नरेन्द्र॥
en: O king, I have obtained the following boon from Indra. Though I shall fall on earth, yet I shall fall among wise and virtuous men.

sa: कृश उवाच राज्ञा परिक्षिता तात मृगयां परिधावता। अवसक्तः पितुस्तेऽद्य मृतः स्कन्धे भुजंगमः॥
en: Krisha said: O dear friend, when Parikshit was roving for the purpose of hunting, he placed the dead snake of the shoulder of your father.

sa: काव्यस्य लेखानार्थाय गणेशः स्मर्यतां मुने। सौतिरुवाच एवमाभाष्य तं ब्रह्मा जगाम स्वं निवेशनम्॥
en: Let Ganesha be remembered, O Rishi, to write this poem. Sauti said : Having thus spoken to Vyasa, Brahma went away to his own place.

sa: देवयान्युवाच यदि मां धर्मकामार्थे प्रत्याख्यास्यसि याचितः। ततः कच न ते विद्या सिद्धिमेषा गमिष्यति॥
en: Devayani said: If you refuse to make me your wife, solicited by me as I do, O Kacha, (indeed I say) your knowledge will bear no fruits.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो द्रोणोऽर्जुनं भूयो हयेषु च गजेषु च। रथेषु भूमावपि च रणशिक्षामशिक्षयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon Drona taught Arjuna the art of fighting on horse back and on the back of the elephants, on car and on the ground.

sa: किमाहत्य विदित्वा वा किं वा कृत्वेह पौरुषम्। दास्याद्वो विप्रमुच्येयं तथ्यं वदत लेलिहाः॥
en: “Tell me, O snakes, by bringing what, or gaining what knowledge or doing what great work, we may be freed from this state of slavery.

sa: नारद उवाच कच्चिदर्थाश्च कल्पन्ते धर्मे च रमते मनः। सुखानि चानुभूयन्ते मनश्च न विहन्यते॥
en: Narada said Is the wealth you are earning spent in proper objects? Dopes you mind take pleasure in virtue? Does not your mind sink under their weight?

sa: स ग्रीष्म अपयाते तु वर्षारात्र उपागते। हन्यास्त्वं लवणं सौम्य स हि कालोऽस्य दुर्मतेः॥
en: When rains shall set in after the expiration of the present summer you should slay him for that is the proper time for destroying that viciousminded one.

sa: तदिदं यच्चिकीर्षामि धर्मं परमसम्मतम्। इष्टं चैव हितं चैव तव चैव कुलस्य च॥
en: Therefore the act I desire to perform is consonant with the highest virtue. It is for your good and for the good of your race.

sa: आस्तीक उवाच सुवर्णं रजतं गाश्च न त्वां राजन्वृणोम्यहम्। सत्रं ते विरमत्वेतत्स्वस्ति मातृकुलस्य नः॥
en: Astika said: O king, I do not ask from you gold, silver or kine. Let your this sacrifice be stopped, so that my maternal relatives are saved.

sa: अयं च बलिनां श्रेष्ठः श्रीमानपि वृकोदरः। युवाभ्यां सहितो वीरः किं न कुर्यान्महायशाः॥
en: This handsome Vrikodara (Bhima) is the foremost of all strong men. Greatly famous as he is, what may not be achieved by him with you.

sa: कामस्य तु रतिर्भार्या शमस्य प्राप्तिरङ्गना। नन्दा तु भार्या हर्षस्य यासु लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः॥
en: The wife of Kama was Rati, that of Shama was Prapti and that of Harsha was Nanda; upon these the worlds were made to depend.

sa: क्षिप्तं क्षिप्तं रणे चैतत् त्वया माधव शत्रुषु। हत्वाप्रतिहतं संख्ये पाणिमेष्यति ते पुनः॥
en: Being hurled at your enemy by you in battle, it will irresistibly kill the enemy and it will then again come back to your hands."

sa: एवं पृष्टोऽब्रवीत् सम्यग् यथावल्लौमहर्षणिः। वाक्यं वचनसंपन्नस्तेषां च चरिताश्रयम्॥ तस्मिन् सदसि विस्तीर्णे मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्।
en: When the accomplished speaker Sauti was thus questioned, he gave before that great assembly of contemplative Rishis a well and proper reply in words becoming their nature.

sa: न त्वहं वधमाकाक्षे स्वयमेवात्मनः शुभे। परैः कृते वधे पापं न किंचिन्मयि विद्यते॥
en: O blessed lady, in sacrificing myself, I do not commit the sin of self destruction. I shall commit no sin by being killed by another.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच भवान् संचरते लोकान् सदा नानाविधान् बहून्। ब्रह्मणा निर्मितान् पूर्वं प्रेक्षमाणो मनोजवः॥
en: Yudhishthira said You possess the sped of mind, you roam over various worlds created in the days of yore by Brahma, thus everywhere seeing everything in them.

sa: यज्ञैर्यजन्ति ये केचिद् याजयन्ति च ये द्विजाः। तान् सर्वान् प्रसभं हत्वा बलिनौ जग्मतुस्ततः॥
en: The two heroes immediately killed those that were performing sacrifices and the Brahmanas that were assisting in those sacrifices. Killing them all, they started for another place.

sa: विकर्णं च महेष्वासं चित्रसेनं च भारत। द्रोणं च परमेष्वासं गौतमं कृपमेव च।॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, Vikarna, the great bowmen Chitrasena, the foremost of bowmen Drona and the son of Gautama Kripa (went out to receive them).

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच स विनिश्चित्य मनसा पाञ्चाल्यं प्रति बुद्धिमान्। जगाम कुरुमुख्यानां नगरं नागसाह्वयम्॥
en: The Brahmana said: Being determined to humiliate the Panchala king, that intelligent man (Drona) went to the city of Hastinapur, the capital of the Kurus.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अच्युताच्युत मा मैवं व्याहरामित्रकर्शन। पाण्डवानां भवान् नाथो भवन्तं चाश्रिता वयम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O Achyuta, O chastiser of foes, do not say so, You are the lord of the Pandavas. We are all dependent on you.

sa: तां दृष्ट्वा तत्र मनुजाः केचिद् भीताः प्रदुद्रुवुः। केचिच्चिन्तापरा जग्मुः केचित् तत्र विचुक्रुशुः॥
en: Seeing her in their midst, some people of the caravan began to fly in fear, some became greatly anxious and some began to cry aloud.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तस्याः कृपणचक्षुर्त्यां प्रदह्येतापि मेदिनी॥ अपि शेषं भवेदद्य पुत्राणां मम संजय।
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, the glances of the affected Draupadi may consume the whole world. Is their any chance of any of my son's living?

sa: आर्ये कर्मणि युञ्जानः पापे वा पुनरीश्वरः। व्याप्य भूतानि चरते न चायमिति लक्ष्यते॥
en: Again, performing actions right or wrong and pervading the universe, the Lord exists but is not perceived by any (who can say) "This is God."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच न च किंचिदथोचुस्तं ह्रिया सन्ना युधिष्ठिरम्। मनोभिरेव कल्याणं दध्युस्ते तस्य धीमतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Those that were present there could not out of shame tell anything to Yudhisthira, but they all prayed for the welfare of the intelligent (king).

sa: पूर्वं हि विहितं कर्म देहिनं न विमुञ्चति। धात्रा विधिरयं दृष्टो बहुधा कर्मनिर्णये॥
en: The acts done before (in one's own former birth) never leave any creature. In determining the various effects of Karma, the Creator did see it.

sa: पश्यामि च महीं राजन् काननैरुपशोभिताम्। यजन्ते हि तदा राजन् ब्राह्मणा बहुभिर्मखैः। :॥
en: O king, I saw there also the earth beautiful with the forests and woods. O king, (I also saw) many Brahmanas engaged in many sacrifices,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स एवमुक्तस्तु महानुभावः सत्यव्रतो भीमसेनेन राजा। अजातशत्रुस्तदनन्तरं वै धैर्यान्वितो वाक्यमिदं बभाषे॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by Bhimasena, the high-souled and ever devoted to truth, Ajatashatru (Yudhishthira), mastering his patience, thus spoke after a few moments.

sa: उपायं न तु पश्यामि येन गच्छेम तद् वनम्। यथा चाभ्यनुजानीयाद् गच्छन्तं मां महीपतिः॥
en: But I do not see the means through which I can go to that forest and by which I may get the permission of the king Dhritarashtra.

sa: चक्रम्यमाणा जीवांश्च धरणीसंश्रितान् बहून्। पद्भ्यां नन्ति नरा विप्र तत्र किं प्रतिभाति ते॥
en: O Brahmana, a man kills innumerable animals that live in the ground by trampling them by their feet. What have you to say to this?

sa: श्रुत्वा तस्य त्वरिता निर्विशङ्काः प्राज्ञा दक्षास्तां तदा चक्रुराशु। सर्वद्रव्याण्युपजह्वः सभायां सहस्रशः शिल्पिनश्चैव युक्ताः॥
en: Hearing (the command), thousands of wise and skillful artificial soon built the palace with the greatest alacrity. Having built it, they brought there every king of article.

sa: लोमश उवाच अस्मिन् किल स्वयं राजन्निष्टवान् वै प्रजापतिः। सत्रमिष्टीकृतं नाम पुरा वर्षसहस्रिकम्॥
en: Lomasha said: O king, here did Prajapati himself perform a sacrifice in the days of yore. It was called Ishtikrita which occupied one thousands years.

sa: व्युषितो रजनीं चाहं कृत्वा पौर्वाहिणकीः क्रियाः। अपश्यं तं द्विजश्रेष्ठं दृष्टवानस्मि यं पुरा॥
en: Having performed my morning devotions when the night drew to a close, I beheld that best of the Brahmanas whom I had previously seen. see

sa: स त्वमातिष्ठ योगं तं येन शीघ्रा हया ममा भवेयुरश्वाध्यक्षोऽसि वेतनं ते शतं शतम्॥
en: Do you adopt some such means that my horses may become very fast. Be then the superintendent of my stables, on a salary of ten thousand coins.

sa: इदं च भूयो वक्ष्यामि सभामध्ये बृहद् वचः। सत्यं देवाः करिष्यन्ति यन्नो युद्धं भविष्यति॥
en: I repeat in the midst of this assembly these proud words which the celestial will surely make good, if ever we engage in battle (with the Kurus).

sa: बलिरुवाच क्षमा स्विच्छ्रेयसी तात उताहो तेज इत्युत। एतन्मे संशयं तात यथावद् ब्रूहि पृच्छते॥
en: Vali said : Does forgiveness lead to well-being, O father or prowess or energy? I have great doubt in this; father, tell me who am asking you.

sa: तं चापि हिसितं तात मुनि मूलफलाशिनम्। श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा च ते तत्र बभूवुर्दीनमानसाः॥
en: O child, on hearing of it and seeing the (dead body) of the Muni who lived on fruits and roots they became sick at heart.

sa: न गङ्गासदृशं तीर्थं न देवः केशवात् परः। ब्राह्मणेभ्यः परं नास्ति एवमाह पितामहः॥
en: There is no Tirtha like the Ganges, there is no god like Keshava (Krishna), there is none superior to Brahmanas thus said the Grandsire (Brahma).

sa: ते तमूचुर्महात्मानं न वयं सत्क्रियां मुने। त्वत्तोऽर्हाः कर्मदोषेण ब्राह्मणो हिसितो हि नः॥
en: They then said to that magnanimous sage, "we are no longer worthy of your reception in as much as we have unfortunately killed a Brahmana."

sa: हनूमानुवाच कएष हनुमान् नाम सागरो येन लवित्तः। पृच्छामि त्वां नरश्रेष्ठ कथ्यतां यदि शक्यते॥
en: Hanuman said: Who is he of the name of Hanuman who leaped over the ocean. O foremost of men I ask you, relate it if you can.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच अर्कपुष्पैस्तु ते पञ्च गणाः पूज्या धनार्थिभिः। व्याधिप्रशमनार्थं च तेषां पूजां समाचरेत्॥
en: Men who are desirous of acquiring wealth should worship these five classes of spirits with the sun-flower. They should also be worshipped for the alleviation of diseases.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच गुरुं निवेद्य विप्राय तौ मातापितरावुभौ। पुनरेव स धर्मात्मा व्याधो ब्राह्मणमब्रवीत्॥
en: Markandeya said : Having introduced both of his parents to that Brahmanas as his highest Gurus that virtuousminded fowler again thus spoke to the Brahmana.

sa: एवं हि खनतां तेषां समुद्रं वरुणालयम्। व्यतीत: सुमहान् कालो न चाश्वः समदृश्यत॥
en: Thus they dug on the ocean, the abode of Varuna, but a long period of time passed away and still the horse was not found.

sa: पुलस्त्य उवाच अनेन तवधर्मज्ञ प्रश्रयेण दमेन च। सत्येन च महाभाग तुष्टोऽस्मि तव सुव्रत॥
en: Pulastya said: O hero of excellent vows, learned in the precepts of virtue, O greatly exalted one, I am much pleased with your humility, self-control and truth.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ते तथा सहिता वीरा वसन्तस्तत्र तत्र ह। क्रमेण पृथिवीपाल नैमिषारण्यमागताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O ruler of earth, those heroes, (the Pandavas) accompanied by their followers, going from place to place, at last reached Naimisha forest.

sa: गुणाभावे फलं न्यूनं भवत्यफलमेव च। अनारम्भे हि न फलं न गुणो दृश्यते क्वचित्॥
en: One element wanting proportionate success does not come or nothing at all; if however no exertion is made no success is acquired, nor any quality is seen.
